examples.correct: misturar ao ambiente

examples.wrong: Você não é adulto.
examples.correct: Você ainda não é adulto.

examples.wrong: Métodos incluem o uso de ferramentas...
examples.correct: As técnicas incluem o uso de ferramentas...

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect use of definite articles and prepositions
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent omission or misuse of definite articles ('o', 'a', 'os', 'as') and prepositions (including crase) in noun phrases and verb constructions, leading to grammatical inaccuracies and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: A localização do Egito conectava-o a outras regiões, promovendo comércio e intercâmbio cultural.
examples.correct: A localização do Egito conectava-o a outras regiões, promovendo o comércio e o intercâmbio cultural.
examples.context: Omission of articles before nouns in educational explanations.

examples.wrong: Trabalhem juntos para achar opções que atendam todos.
examples.correct: Trabalhem juntos para achar opções que atendam a todos.
examples.context: Missing preposition required by the verb 'atender'.

examples.wrong: Este comportamento é um exemplo de bondade diária que pode ser facilmente incorporado na rotina diária de alguém.
examples.correct: Este comportamento é um exemplo de bondade diária que pode ser facilmente incorporado à rotina diária de alguém.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of phrases or constructions that are grammatically correct but not idiomatic or clear in Brazilian Portuguese, affecting the naturalness and comprehension of educational material.

examples.wrong: Pressione forte e rápido, 100-120 compressões por minuto.
examples.correct: Pressione com força e rapidez, 100-120 compressões por minuto.

examples.wrong: Plano de evacuação: Crie e pratique um plano de fuga familiar com duas saídas de cada cômodo.
examples.correct: Plano de evacuação: Crie e pratique um plano de fuga para a família com duas saídas de cada cômodo.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of words or expressions that are grammatically correct but not idiomatic or precise in Brazilian Portuguese, affecting clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: Ratos-canguru que sobrevivem sem beber água...
examples.correct: Ratos-canguru que sobrevivem sem ingerir água...

examples.wrong: habilidades sociais fortes
examples.correct: habilidades sociais sólidas
examples.context: Describing social skills in group work

top_error_patterns.description: Mistakes in matching gender and number between nouns, adjectives, and verbs, which can confuse learners and reduce the professionalism of the content.

examples.wrong: Strings podem ser armazenados como números.
examples.correct: Strings podem ser armazenadas como números.
examples.context: Incorrect gender agreement with the noun 'strings'.

examples.wrong: compartilhar tal dados pessoal
examples.correct: compartilhar tais dados pessoais
examples.context: Mismatch in number and gender in noun phrase.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect sentence type for Yes/No questions
top_error_patterns.description: Statements are used instead of questions in Yes/No quiz items, missing the question mark and proper interrogative structure.

examples.wrong: O numerador pode ser maior que o denominador em uma fração.
examples.correct: O numerador pode ser maior que o denominador em uma fração?
examples.context: Yes/No question context in math quizzes

examples.correct: Toda fração é maior que um todo?
examples.context: Yes/No question context in math quizzes

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Grammatical agreement and article usage errors
top_error_patterns.description: Omission or incorrect use of definite articles, verb conjugation mismatches, and number agreement errors that affect sentence correctness.

examples.wrong: Desperdício de materiais e energia não tem impacto...
examples.correct: O desperdício de materiais e energia não tem impacto...

examples.wrong: Exemplos incluem mastros de bandeira...
examples.correct: Exemplos incluem mastros de bandeiras...

examples.wrong: Por exemplo, enquanto mercados emergentes como China e Índia prosperam...
examples.correct: Por exemplo, enquanto mercados emergentes como a China e a Índia prosperam...

top_error_patterns.description: Spelling mistakes and use of European Portuguese variants instead of Brazilian Portuguese, which can distract learners and reduce localization quality.

examples.wrong: prototipos
examples.correct: protótipos
examples.context: Missing accent in a scientific term.

examples.wrong: Percentagens
examples.correct: Porcentagens
examples.context: European Portuguese variant instead of Brazilian Portuguese.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural References Not Adapted for Brazilian Context
top_error_patterns.description: Examples, anecdotes, or references that are US-centric or globally generic, rather than locally relevant, reducing relatability and engagement for Brazilian students.

examples.wrong: Exemplos incluem os Estados Unidos importando eletrônicos da China e exportando produtos agrícolas como trigo e milho...
examples.correct: Exemplos incluem o Brasil importando eletrônicos da China e exportando produtos agrícolas como soja e café...

examples.wrong: Michael Jordan, considerado um dos maiores jogadores de basquete de todos os tempos...
examples.correct: Use a Brazilian sports figure or provide more context.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of general or imprecise terms instead of standard scientific or technical vocabulary, affecting accuracy and comprehension.

examples.wrong: segmento de linha
examples.correct: segmento de reta

examples.wrong: forma de matéria
examples.correct: estado da matéria

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or Unnatural Imperative and Instructional Style
top_error_patterns.description: Use of impersonal or singular imperative forms in instructions where plural or direct forms are more natural and engaging for Brazilian learners.

examples.wrong: Evitar escrever em CAIXA ALTA, que pode parecer gritar.
examples.correct: Evite escrever em CAIXA ALTA, pois isso pode ser interpretado como grito.

examples.wrong: Trabalhe juntos para encontrar soluções.
examples.correct: Trabalhem juntos para encontrar soluções.

top_error_patterns.description: References to foreign currency or formats that do not match Brazilian standards, reducing cultural fit and comprehension.

examples.wrong: Uma moeda de 25 centavos vale 1/4 de um dólar.
examples.correct: Uma moeda de 25 centavos vale 1/4 de um real.

top_error_patterns.description: The abbreviation 'Ex.:' is repeatedly used instead of the standard 'Exemplo:' in Brazilian Portuguese educational materials, affecting clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: Ex.: pão, arroz, frutas.
examples.correct: Exemplo: pão, arroz, frutas.

examples.wrong: Ex.: arroz, macarrão
examples.correct: Exemplo: arroz, macarrão

examples.wrong: Ex.: espinafre, maçãs
examples.correct: Exemplo: espinafre, maçãs

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or missing punctuation and capitalization
top_error_patterns.description: Minor errors such as missing commas, unnecessary exclamation marks, incorrect capitalization at sentence start, or improper use of hyphens.

examples.wrong: O número `5` na equação `x + 5 = 10` é de fato uma constante...
examples.correct: O número `5` na equação `x + 5 = 10` é, de fato, uma constante...

examples.wrong: raios-X
examples.correct: raios X
examples.context: Compound noun spelling in science content

examples.wrong: a Torá é o texto sagrado...
examples.correct: A Torá é o texto sagrado...
examples.context: Capitalization at start of bullet point

top_error_patterns.description: Use of adjectives instead of adverbs in formal educational contexts, reducing grammatical precision.

examples.wrong: crescem mais rápido do que em áreas sombreadas
examples.correct: crescem mais rapidamente do que em áreas sombreadas
examples.context: Describing growth rates in science content

examples.wrong: crescem mais rápido foi confirmada...
examples.correct: crescem mais rapidamente foi confirmada...

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-Localized Formatting of Numbers and Dates
top_error_patterns.description: Formatting conventions for numbers and date ranges follow English standards rather than Brazilian Portuguese, which can cause confusion or reduce cultural fit.

examples.wrong: século V–IV a.C.
examples.correct: século V a IV a.C.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of half-width periods ('.'), double periods, or unnecessary Western punctuation at the end of Japanese sentences, which disrupts readability and violates Japanese orthographic conventions.

examples.wrong: ナイル川はエジプトの生涯にわたる経済発展の重要な要因でした.
examples.correct: ナイル川はエジプトの長きにわたる経済発展の重要な要因でした。
examples.context: Sentence ends with half-width period instead of Japanese full stop.

examples.wrong: 感情は私たちが自然に経験するものです。異なる人々は異なる感情を持つことがありますが、感情自体は全員が経験するものではありません。...
examples.correct: 感情は私たちが自然に経験するものです。異なる人々は異なる感情を持つことがありますが、感情自体は全員が経験するものです。

examples.wrong: 儿童は自分の感情を完全に理解することができます。.
examples.correct: 子どもは自分の感情を完全に理解することができます。
examples.context: Half-width period after Japanese full stop.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Lexical errors and unnatural word choices
top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard, incorrect, or unnatural words and phrases that are not appropriate in Japanese, leading to confusion or misinterpretation.

examples.wrong: 冷却帯の温度は非常に高いため、生物多様性が豊かです。
examples.correct: 極地気候帯の温度は非常に低いため、生物多様性は限られています。

examples.wrong: 冷革な対話が続きます。
examples.correct: 冷静な対話が続きます。
examples.context: Non-existent word '冷革' instead of '冷静'.

examples.wrong: 物語の中心的なアイデアは物語の説得力としかりみです。
examples.correct: 物語の中心的なアイデアは物語の説得力と魅力です。
examples.context: Typographical error 'しかりみ' instead of '魅力'.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of incorrect grammatical structures, negative forms, or logical contradictions that obscure meaning and reduce clarity.

examples.wrong: 三角形には頂点が3つすべてではありません。
examples.correct: 三角形には必ず3つの頂点があります。
examples.context: Logical contradiction and incorrect negative construction.

examples.wrong: オンラインで共有される情報は必ずしも重要です。.
examples.correct: オンラインで共有される情報は必ずしも重要ではありません。

examples.wrong: 族は同じ族に属する元素の数の電子が同じであることによって決まります。.
examples.correct: 族は同じ族に属する元素の外殻電子の数が同じであることによって決まります。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Use of non-Japanese or corrupted characters
top_error_patterns.description: Presence of Chinese terms, corrupted text, or incomplete words due to encoding errors, which severely impact comprehension and professionalism.

examples.wrong: 儿童は自分の感情を完全に理解することができます。.
examples.correct: 子どもは自分の感情を完全に理解することができます。
examples.context: Chinese term '儿童' instead of Japanese '子ども'.

examples.wrong: 強力なパスワードは短く簡����antoいすることが推奨されます。.
examples.correct: 強力なパスワードは短く簡単にすることが推奨されます。

examples.wrong: アメリカの選挙は公開され、市民が自由に参加することができる民主的なプロセスです。この誤解を解消するために、選挙はどのような民主主義の基礎であるかを考えてみてくだ�。
examples.correct: アメリカの選挙は公開され、市民が自由に参加することができる民主的なプロセスです。この誤解を解消するために、選挙はどのような民主主義の基礎であるかを考えてみてください。
examples.context: Incomplete word due to encoding error.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of incorrect scientific terms or factual errors that misrepresent key concepts, affecting educational accuracy and learner trust.

examples.wrong: 原子構成は元素の酸素電子数によって決定されます。.
examples.correct: 原子構成は元素の原子番号によって決定されます。
examples.context: Non-standard term '酸素電子数' instead of '原子番号'.

examples.wrong: 核電荷が周期によって減少する.
examples.correct: 核電荷は周期によって増加する。

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that misrepresent key concepts, leading to factual inaccuracies and confusion for learners.

examples.wrong: ノンフィクション書は、歴史上の人物の生活についての創作物です。
examples.correct: ノンフィクション書は、歴史上の人物の生活についての創作物ではありません。
examples.context: Definition of non-fiction misrepresented, causing misunderstanding of genre distinctions.

top_error_patterns.description: Selection of words that are culturally inappropriate or unnatural in educational contexts, reducing clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: 記憶の力を最大限に活用する秘謀です。
examples.correct: 記憶の力を最大限に活用する方法です。
examples.context: Use of '秘謀' (secret plot) instead of '方法' (method) in instructional content.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Sentence ends with both Japanese full stop (。) and half-width period (.)
top_error_patterns.description: Sentences frequently end with a Japanese full stop (。) immediately followed by a half-width period (.), resulting in double punctuation. This is not standard in Japanese writing and affects professionalism and readability.

examples.wrong: 古代エジプトではファラオの権力が絶えず変わり、各ファラオは建築に大きな貢納を求めませんでした.
examples.correct: 古代エジプトではファラオの権力が絶えず変わり、各ファラオは建築に大きな貢納を求めませんでした。

examples.wrong: 感情は私たちの経験に影響を与える。.
examples.correct: 感情は私たちの経験に影響を与える。

examples.wrong: 科学的手法は主に芸術的なスキルの発展を目指すために使われます。.
examples.correct: 科学的手法は主に芸術的なスキルの発展を目指すために使われます。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Sentence ends with half-width period (.) instead of full-width Japanese period (。)
top_error_patterns.description: Sentences end with a half-width period (.) rather than the standard Japanese full-width period (。), which is incorrect in Japanese writing and affects the naturalness and correctness of the text.

examples.wrong: 感情知能を持つ人は、自分の感情や他人の感情のニュアンスをより深く理解することができる.
examples.correct: 感情知能を持つ人は、自分の感情や他人の感情のニュアンスをより深く理解することができる。

examples.wrong: 困難な課題を避けることが成長にとって最も有益である.
examples.correct: 困難な課題を避けることが成長にとって最も有益である。

examples.wrong: イオン推進システムは化学ロケットよりも速い速度で宇宙に到達できます.
examples.correct: イオン推進システムは化学ロケットよりも速い速度で宇宙に到達できます。

top_error_patterns.description: Use of kanji or terms that are incorrect or unnatural in Japanese, often due to direct translation or confusion with similar Chinese characters.

examples.wrong: 資源が豊富な地域は経済が繁荣することが一般的です。.
examples.correct: 資源が豊富な地域は経済が繁栄することが一般的です。
examples.context: Incorrect kanji '繁荣' used instead of '繁栄'; also contains mixed punctuation.

examples.wrong: グローバル貿易は経済成長を消減させることがあります。
examples.correct: グローバル貿易は経済成長を減少させることがあります。
examples.context: Non-standard term '消減' used instead of the natural '減少'.

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences end with both Japanese and Western periods, or contain unnecessary punctuation, which disrupts readability and professionalism.

examples.wrong: 資源が豊富な地域は経済が繁荣することが一般的です。.
examples.correct: 資源が豊富な地域は経済が繁栄することが一般的です。
examples.context: Ends with both Japanese full stop and English period.

examples.wrong: その通りです。感情は私たちの経験、たとえそれが短期間であっても長期間もあります。喜びや悲しみ、怒りなど、感情は私たちの行動や考え方に影響を与え、人間関係において重要な役割を果たします。.
examples.correct: その通りです。感情は私たちの経験、たとえそれが短期間であっても長期間であってもあります。喜びや悲しみ、怒りなど、感情は私たちの行動や考え方に影響を与え、人間関係において重要な役割を果たします。

top_error_patterns.description: Use of verb forms that are grammatically incorrect or unnatural in Japanese, affecting clarity and flow.

examples.wrong: イデーションは困難を探しているプロセスです。
examples.correct: イデーションは困難を探すプロセスです。
examples.context: Continuous verb form '探している' used instead of the more appropriate '探す'.

examples.wrong: 記憶術は、覚えやすいものや既知のものに情報を関連付けることで記憶を助けるツールです。
examples.correct: 記憶術は、覚えやすいものや既知のものに情報を関連付けて記憶を助ける方法です。
examples.context: Verb phrase and noun choice ('ツール' vs '方法') are unnatural for educational context.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnatural lexical choices or direct loan translations
top_error_patterns.description: Use of words or phrases that are direct translations from English or otherwise unnatural in Japanese, reducing clarity and localization fit.

examples.wrong: これは、相互作用がフィールドが異なる可能性があるためです。
examples.correct: これは、相互作用する相手の背景が異なる可能性があるためです。
examples.context: Direct loan 'フィールド' used instead of natural '背景'.

examples.wrong: デジタルエチケットは、私がオンラインで見せる外見が全ての世界で受け取られるという考えに基づいていません。
examples.correct: デジタルエチケットは、私がオンラインで見せる外見が全ての世界で受け入れられるという考えに基づいていません。
examples.context: Incorrect verb '受け取られる' used instead of '受け入れられる'.

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences contain awkward phrasing or incorrect particle usage, making them difficult to understand or less idiomatic.

examples.wrong: この私たちの食事には、炭水化物をサラダやご飯に、タンパク質を鶏肉や豆腐に、脂質をオリーブオイルやナッツにとることで摂取する食材が含まれています。
examples.correct: 私たちの食事には、サラダやご飯から炭水化物、鶏肉や豆腐からタンパク質、オリーブオイルやナッツから脂質を摂取する食材が含まれています。
examples.context: Unnatural phrasing and incorrect particle usage for nutrient sources.

examples.wrong: 陰影の技法には、光源の位置が関係ない。
examples.correct: 陰影の技法には、光源の位置が関係ありません。
examples.context: Plain negative form used instead of polite form, affecting tone and register.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of backticks and asterisks for math expressions is not standard in Japanese educational content. Proper formatting uses plain numbers/variables and the multiplication sign (×).

examples.wrong:
シャツ一枚の値段が`20`円で、3枚購入すると合計費用は:
- `x = 20`（シャツ1枚の値段）  
- 合計 = `3 * x = 3 * 20 = 60`円
examples.correct:
シャツ一枚の値段が20円で、3枚購入すると合計費用は:
- x = 20（シャツ1枚の値段）
- 合計 = 3 × x = 3 × 20 = 60円

top_error_patterns.description: Direct translations about copyright (e.g., gratitude and payment for permission) are unnatural and may mislead learners. Standard Japanese uses '許可を得るべきです' for clarity.

examples.wrong: オリジナルの作品の著作者に感謝と支払いの形で承認を得るべきです。
examples.correct: オリジナルの作品の著作者から許可を得るべきです。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Misleading or unclear terminology for genre definitions
top_error_patterns.description: Genre definitions (e.g., non-fiction) use ambiguous or informal phrasing. Polite, clear forms are preferred for educational clarity.

examples.wrong: ノンフィクションは完全に架空の世界ではない。
examples.correct: ノンフィクションは完全に架空の世界ではありません。

top_error_patterns.description: Directly translated scientific phrases (e.g., '証拠を提供します') are less natural in Japanese. Use '示しています' for clearer, culturally appropriate explanations.

examples.wrong: これらの記憶テクニックは脳の構造が認知機能をサポートする証拠を提供します。
examples.correct: これらの記憶テクニックは脳の構造が認知機能を支えることを示しています。

top_error_patterns.description: Use of US-style phone numbers is inappropriate for Japanese learners. Japanese phone number formats should be used for cultural relevance.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Sentence ends with two consecutive full-width periods (..)
top_error_patterns.description: Sentences end with two consecutive full-width periods (..), which is not standard in Japanese and can distract readers. Only one full-width period should be used.

examples.wrong: 三角形の種類について学んでいるところなので、正三角形という名前が指しているのは、その特徴である3つの等しい辺についてのことです..
examples.correct: 三角形の種類について学んでいるところなので、正三角形という名前が指しているのは、その特徴である3つの等しい辺についてのことです。

examples.wrong: 固定マインドセットは、自分の能力が固定されていると考え、挑戦や障害に直面することを避けがちです。この認識は、個人が新しいスキルを学び、成長する機会を見過ごす可能性があります..
examples.correct: 固定マインドセットは、自分の能力が固定されていると考え、挑戦や障害に直面することを避けがちです。この認識は、個人が新しいスキルを学び、成長する機会を見過ごす可能性があります。

examples.wrong: ニュートンの万有引力の法則は、物体間の距離が変わると引力が変動することを考慮しています。地球から離れるために必要な速度は、距離が着実に減少するにつれて確実に減少します..
examples.correct: ニュートンの万有引力の法則は、物体間の距離が変わると引力が変動することを考慮しています。地球から離れるために必要な速度は、距離が着実に減少するにつれて確実に減少します。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnecessary comma (、) after topic marker or at start of sentence
top_error_patterns.description: Commas (、) are placed after the topic marker 'は' or at the start of sentences, which is unnecessary in Japanese and disrupts the natural flow. This is a minor orthographic issue.

examples.wrong: 人権は、すべての人に平等に与えられる基本的な権利です。
examples.correct: 人権はすべての人に平等に与えられる基本的な権利です。

examples.wrong: 例えば、エレノア・ルーズベルトは、世界人権宣言を「すべての人々と国々のための共通の達成基準」と表現しました。
examples.correct: 例えばエレノア・ルーズベルトは世界人権宣言を「すべての人々と国々のための共通の達成基準」と表現しました。

examples.wrong: 世界人権宣言は、戦争の恐怖や抑圧が再び起こることを防ぐために作成されました。
examples.correct: 世界人権宣言は戦争の恐怖や抑圧が再び起こることを防ぐために作成されました。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Emoji or informal symbol at end of educational sentence
top_error_patterns.description: Use of emoji (e.g., 🌱) at the end of formal educational content is not standard and can affect the professional tone. Emojis should be avoided unless pedagogically justified.

examples.wrong: 生命の基本を理解するための重要なステップです！ 🌱
examples.correct: 生命の基本を理解するための重要なステップです！

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Use of Emojis in Formal Contexts
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as '🌏' are used in educational content, which can undermine the professional tone expected in formal Japanese materials.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnatural Loanword Usage for Educational Terminology
top_error_patterns.description: Loanwords like 'メカニズム' are used where more natural Japanese terms such as '仕組み' would improve clarity and fit for educational content.

examples.wrong: 記憶の保存を強化するメカニズムです。
examples.correct: 記憶の定着を強化する仕組みです。
examples.context: Explanations of scientific or educational concepts

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent mismatches between subject and verb in gender and number, especially with feminine plural nouns and collective subjects, leading to confusion and ungrammatical sentences.

examples.wrong: الحيوانات تطوروا بطرق مذهلات لكي يعيشوا في بيئاتهم
examples.correct: الحيوانات تطورت بطرق مذهلة لكي تعيش في بيئاتها
examples.context: Subject 'الحيوانات' (feminine plural) incorrectly paired with masculine plural verbs.

examples.wrong: هذي التكيفات مفتاح لفهم كيف الأنواع يبقوا في أنظمة بيئية مختلفة
examples.correct: هذه التكيفات مفتاح لفهم كيف تبقى الأنواع في أنظمة بيئية مختلفة
examples.context: Plural noun 'الأنواع' incorrectly paired with plural verb instead of singular feminine.

examples.wrong: التكيفات هو صفات أو سلوكيات يساعدوا الكائنات يعيشوا ويتكاثروا في بيئتهم
examples.correct: التكيفات هي صفات أو سلوكيات تساعد الكائنات على العيش والتكاثر في بيئتها
examples.context: Plural subject 'التكيفات' incorrectly paired with singular verb 'هو' and plural verb 'يساعدوا'.

examples.wrong: طيور تهاجر جنوب في شتاء عشان يهربوا من برد ويلقوا أكل
examples.correct: تتهاجر الطيور جنوبًا في الشتاء لكي تهرب من البرد وتجد الطعام
examples.context: Subject 'الطيور' incorrectly paired with plural verb 'يهربوا' instead of singular feminine.

examples.wrong: التكيفات سلوكية هم تغييرات جسدية اللي حيوان يمر عشان يعي
examples.correct: التكيفات السلوكية ليست تغييرات جسدية يمر بها الحيوان لكي يعيش
examples.context: Subject 'التكيفات السلوكية' incorrectly paired with 'هم' instead of 'ليست'.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Definite Article and Noun Agreement Errors
top_error_patterns.description: Omission or incorrect use of the definite article 'ال' with nouns and adjectives, leading to ambiguity and lack of clarity.

examples.wrong: طرق مذهلات
examples.correct: طرق مذهلة
examples.context: Adjective agreement and definite article missing.

examples.wrong: تمويه
examples.correct: التمويه

examples.wrong: في شتاء
examples.correct: في الشتاء
examples.context: Definite article missing with time expressions.

examples.wrong: التكيفات سلوكية
examples.correct: التكيفات السلوكية
examples.context: Definite article missing with compound noun.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of colloquial forms and expressions instead of Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), reducing professionalism and clarity in educational content.

examples.wrong: هذي التكيفات
examples.correct: هذه التكيفات
examples.context: Colloquial demonstrative 'هذي' used instead of MSA 'هذه'.

examples.wrong: عشان يهربوا من برد ويلقوا أكل
examples.correct: لكي تهرب من البرد وتجد الطعام

examples.wrong: اللي حيوان يمر عشان يعي
examples.correct: يمر بها الحيوان لكي يعيش
examples.context: Colloquial 'اللي' and incomplete phrase used instead of standard MSA.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Colloquial Expressions in Place of Standard Arabic
top_error_patterns.description: Use of colloquial words or structures (e.g., 'اللي', 'عنده', 'يعملوا') instead of Modern Standard Arabic, reducing professionalism and clarity.

examples.wrong: أفعال اللي الحيوانات يعملوا، مثل سبات أو هجرة.
examples.correct: أفعال تقوم بها الحيوانات، مثل السبات أو الهجرة.
examples.context: Quiz item describing animal behaviors; uses colloquial relative pronoun and verb.

examples.wrong: الثعلب القطبي عنده فرو أبيض يختلط مع الثلج، ويساعده يهرب من مفترسات.
examples.correct: الثعلب القطبي لديه فرو أبيض يندمج مع الثلج، مما يساعده على الهروب من المفترسات.
examples.context: Describing animal adaptation; uses colloquial possession and verb forms.

top_error_patterns.description: Mismatch between pronouns and verbs with their referents, leading to confusion and grammatical errors.

examples.wrong: هم يتطور خلال أجيال عبر عملية الاختيار الطبيعي.
examples.correct: وهي تتطور خلال أجيال عبر عملية الانتقاء الطبيعي.
examples.context: Refers to 'التكيفات' (feminine plural) but uses masculine pronoun and verb.

examples.wrong: أفعال اللي الحيوانات يعملوا، مثل سبات أو هجرة.
examples.correct: أفعال تقوم بها الحيوانات، مثل السبات أو الهجرة.
examples.context: Verb does not agree with the subject 'الحيوانات'.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Missing or Incorrect Use of Definite Articles
top_error_patterns.description: Omission of definite articles ('ال') in scientific or descriptive contexts, affecting clarity and correctness.

examples.wrong: أفعال اللي الحيوانات يعملوا، مثل سبات أو هجرة.
examples.correct: أفعال تقوم بها الحيوانات، مثل السبات أو الهجرة.

examples.wrong: يساعده يهرب من مفترسات.
examples.correct: مما يساعده على الهروب من المفترسات.

top_error_patterns.description: Definite articles (الـ) are omitted before nouns, reducing clarity and grammatical correctness in Modern Standard Arabic.

examples.wrong: خصائص جسم حيوان، مثل فرو، مخالب أو رقبة طويلة.
examples.correct: خصائص جسم الحيوان، مثل الفرو، والمخالب، أو الرقبة الطويلة.
examples.context: Quiz item descriptions listing animal body features.

top_error_patterns.description: Emojis are used in educational Arabic content, which can undermine the formal and professional tone expected in academic settings.

examples.context: Appears in quiz content where a formal style is required.

top_error_patterns.description: Pronouns are used in plural form ('los', 'les') when the subject is singular, leading to confusion and grammatical errors.

examples.wrong: Su grueso pelaje y capa de grasa los mantienen calientes en el Ártico.
examples.correct: Su grueso pelaje y capa de grasa lo mantienen caliente en el Ártico.
examples.context: Referring to 'oso polar' (singular) with a plural pronoun.

examples.wrong: Su pelaje blanco les ayuda a camuflarse.
examples.correct: Su pelaje blanco lo ayuda a camuflarse.
examples.context: Referring to 'oso polar' (singular) with a plural pronoun.

top_error_patterns.description: Non-standard or incorrect terms are used for established medical concepts, reducing clarity and professional accuracy.

examples.wrong: RCP (Resucitación Cardiopulmonar)
examples.correct: RCP (Reanimación Cardiopulmonar)
examples.context: Medical terminology for CPR in Spanish.

top_error_patterns.description: References to emergency numbers use '911', which is not standard in most Spanish-speaking countries. The correct approach is to use '112' or indicate that the number varies by country.

examples.wrong: Llama a los servicios de emergencia (como el 911) una vez fuera.
examples.correct: Llama a los servicios de emergencia (como el 112 o el número local correspondiente) una vez fuera.
examples.context: Instructions for contacting emergency services in educational content.

top_error_patterns.description: English terms such as 'Mnemonics' are used instead of their proper Spanish equivalents, which can confuse learners and reduce cultural appropriateness.

examples.wrong: Mnemonics
examples.correct: Mnemotecnia

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Use of Emojis in Educational Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as 🌟, 😊, 📜, and ✨ are frequently used in introductions and explanations, which is not standard in formal Spanish educational materials. Their presence can reduce perceived professionalism and distract from the academic message.

examples.wrong: ¡Bienvenidos! Hoy vamos a viajar en el tiempo para descubrir una de las civilizaciones más fascinantes de la historia: el Antiguo Egipto. ... 🌍
examples.correct: ¡Bienvenidos! Hoy vamos a viajar en el tiempo para descubrir una de las civilizaciones más fascinantes de la historia: el Antiguo Egipto. ...

examples.wrong: ¡Bienvenidos a una emocionante aventura en el mundo de la programación! 🌟 ...
examples.correct: ¡Bienvenidos a una emocionante aventura en el mundo de la programación! ...

examples.wrong: ¡Prepárate para aprender habilidades que pueden salvar vidas! 🩹🔥🫁
examples.correct: ¡Prepárate para aprender habilidades que pueden salvar vidas!

top_error_patterns.description: Use of literal translations, anglicisms, or non-standard terms instead of widely accepted Spanish terminology, leading to reduced clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: pies anchos para caminar en la arena
examples.correct: patas anchas para caminar en la arena

examples.wrong: paneles solares de las células vegetales
examples.correct: captadores de energía de las células vegetales

examples.wrong: chips
examples.correct: semiconductores

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that are either literal translations, regionally specific, or less precise, which can hinder comprehension for a broad Spanish-speaking audience. Corrections use standard, widely accepted terminology.

examples.wrong: manija de puerta
examples.correct: picaporte

examples.wrong: resbaladilla
examples.correct: tobogán

examples.wrong: mazo estándar de cartas
examples.correct: baraja estándar de cartas

top_error_patterns.description: Direct translations from English result in awkward or less natural phrasing in Spanish, affecting clarity and engagement. Corrections use more idiomatic Spanish expressions.

examples.wrong: Prepárense para descubrir los secretos detrás de la exploración espacial...
examples.correct: Prepárense para descubrir los secretos de la exploración espacial...

examples.wrong: Estas estrategias, originadas en la antigua retórica griega...
examples.correct: Estas estrategias, que tienen su origen en la retórica griega antigua...

examples.wrong: Animarte a ti mismo cuando cometes errores.
examples.correct: Animarte cuando cometes errores.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural References Not Adapted for Spanish Audience
top_error_patterns.description: Examples, mnemonics, or references that are either irrelevant, unfamiliar, or less appropriate for Spanish-speaking learners, reducing engagement and cultural fit.

examples.wrong: Novelas como *Harry Potter* de J.K. Rowling.
examples.correct: Novelas como *Cien años de soledad* de Gabriel García Márquez.

examples.wrong: "I antes de E excepto después de C"
examples.correct: Este ejemplo no es relevante en español; se recomienda eliminarlo o reemplazarlo por una regla ortográfica española.

examples.wrong: Ser ciudadano de EE.UU.
examples.correct: Ser ciudadano estadounidense.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Literal Translation of Phrases and Imperatives
top_error_patterns.description: Direct translation of English phrases or imperatives that result in unnatural or less idiomatic Spanish, affecting clarity and engagement.

examples.wrong: hacer elecciones inteligentes
examples.correct: tomar decisiones inteligentes

examples.wrong: te empodera para vivir tu mejor vida
examples.correct: te ayuda a vivir de la mejor manera

examples.wrong: Imaginen un día sin agua, electricidad o combustible.
examples.correct: Imagina un día sin agua, electricidad o combustible.

top_error_patterns.description: Recurring misuse of punctuation, such as em dashes instead of semicolons, missing exclamation marks, incorrect use of colons, and capitalization after colons. These errors affect readability and adherence to Spanish writing conventions.

examples.wrong: El ciberacoso tiene consecuencias serias—sé proactivo en prevenirlo y abordarlo.
examples.correct: El ciberacoso tiene consecuencias serias; sé proactivo en prevenirlo y abordarlo.
examples.context: Em dash used instead of semicolon to separate clauses.

examples.wrong: Rabia, rabia contra la muerte de la luz.
examples.correct: ¡Rabia, rabia contra la muerte de la luz!
examples.context: Missing exclamation marks in exclamatory sentence.

examples.wrong: Recuerda, en cortes profundos, mantén presión y busca ayuda médica.
examples.correct: Recuerda: en cortes profundos, mantén presión y busca ayuda médica.
examples.context: Comma used instead of colon to introduce advice.

examples.wrong: Desplazamiento laboral: La automatización puede reemplazar empleos humanos.
examples.correct: Desplazamiento laboral: la automatización puede reemplazar empleos humanos.
examples.context: Capitalization after colon where lowercase is required.

examples.wrong: Eres más hermosa y más templada:
examples.correct: Eres más hermosa y más templada;
examples.context: Colon used at end of poetic line instead of semicolon.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or Unnatural Scientific and Technical Terms
top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that are not standard in Spanish scientific, medical, or technical discourse, leading to confusion or lack of precision.

examples.wrong: tirones gravitatorios
examples.correct: asistencias gravitacionales

examples.wrong: alarmas de humo
examples.correct: detectores de humo

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission or misuse of definite articles and prepositions
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent omission or incorrect use of definite articles ('los', 'el') and prepositions ('a') when referring to general or specific groups, leading to unnatural or incomplete sentences.

examples.wrong: Osos que reducen su actividad en invierno para conservar energía.
examples.correct: Los osos reducen su actividad en invierno para conservar energía.
examples.context: Missing definite article when referring to animals in general.

examples.wrong: Murciélagos y búhos cazan de noche para evitar depredadores.
examples.correct: Murciélagos y búhos cazan de noche para evitar a los depredadores.
examples.context: Omission of preposition and article when referring to a group.

examples.wrong: pesca pequeña escala
examples.correct: pesca a pequeña escala
examples.context: Missing preposition in a fixed expression.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Literal translation of idioms and technical terms
top_error_patterns.description: Use of literal translations for idioms or technical terms instead of standard or natural Spanish expressions, resulting in awkwardness or reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: Ponerte en los zapatos de otra persona para entender sus sentimientos y punto de vista.
examples.correct: Ponerse en el lugar de otra persona para entender sus sentimientos y punto de vista.
examples.context: Literal translation of English idiom instead of natural Spanish equivalent.

examples.wrong: La tabla periódica es un cuadro que organiza todos los elementos químicos...
examples.correct: La tabla periódica es una tabla que organiza todos los elementos químicos...
examples.context: Incorrect technical term for 'table' in scientific context.

examples.wrong: No entres dócilmente en esa buena noche,
examples.correct: No entres dócilmente en esa dulce noche,
examples.context: Literal translation of poetic metaphor instead of culturally resonant term.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission or inconsistency of articles and possessive adjectives
top_error_patterns.description: Articles and possessive adjectives are sometimes omitted or inconsistently applied in lists or parallel structures, reducing grammatical clarity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: Las máscaras y disfraces representan libertad y creatividad...
examples.correct: Las máscaras y los disfraces representan libertad y creatividad...
examples.context: Missing article 'los' before 'disfraces' in a list.

examples.wrong: Evita divulgar información personal como tu número de teléfono o dirección.
examples.correct: Evita divulgar información personal como tu número de teléfono o tu dirección.
examples.context: Possessive adjective 'tu' omitted before 'dirección' in a list.

examples.wrong: Trabajar como funcionario electoral o en mesas de votación.
examples.correct: Trabajar como funcionario electoral o en una mesa de votación.
examples.context: Plural 'mesas' used where singular is more natural and clear.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or inconsistent use of verb forms
top_error_patterns.description: Verb forms are sometimes used incorrectly or inconsistently, especially in instructions, affecting clarity and tone. This includes using infinitives instead of imperatives and less idiomatic verb choices.

examples.wrong: Presentar tu experimento en una feria científica o escribir un informe.
examples.correct: Presenta tu experimento en una feria científica o escribe un informe.
examples.context: Infinitive used instead of imperative in instructional context.

examples.wrong: Antes de compartir una foto grupal..., pide permiso a todos los involucrados para asegurarte de que están cómodos...
examples.correct: Antes de compartir una foto grupal..., pide permiso a todos los involucrados para asegurarte de que se sienten cómodos...
examples.context: Less idiomatic verb choice for expressing comfort.

examples.wrong: Enfría la zona con agua corriente por 10 minutos.
examples.correct: Enfría la zona con agua corriente durante 10 minutos.
examples.context: Incorrect preposition 'por' used instead of 'durante' for time span.

top_error_patterns.description: Mixing formal and informal address or inconsistent use of singular/plural forms, which can confuse learners and reduce professionalism.

examples.wrong: ¡Bienvenidos a una aventura para mejorar tu memoria!
examples.correct: ¡Bienvenidos a una aventura para mejorar su memoria!

top_error_patterns.description: Errors in pluralization or agreement between nouns and adjectives, leading to grammatical inconsistencies and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: Visualización: Hacerlo Memorables
examples.correct: Visualización: Hacerlo Memorable
examples.context: Adjective does not agree in number with the noun.

examples.wrong: difuminos
examples.correct: difumino
examples.context: Incorrect plural form of a technical term.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard terminology or direct anglicisms instead of accepted Spanish terms, affecting professionalism and clarity.

examples.wrong: Ley de Derecho al Voto de 1965
examples.correct: Ley de Derechos Electorales de 1965
examples.context: Literal translation of legal term instead of official Spanish name.

examples.wrong: DJing
examples.correct: DJ
examples.context: Anglicism not standard in Spanish orthography.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Misuse of participles and gerunds for logical relationships
top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect use of participles instead of gerunds to express logical relationships, leading to ambiguity or misinterpretation.

examples.wrong: Decide si tu hipótesis fue correcta basada en la evidencia.
examples.correct: Decide si tu hipótesis fue correcta basándote en la evidencia.
examples.context: Participial phrase incorrectly modifies the noun instead of the action.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Numbers Below Ten Written as Numerals in Non-Mathematical Contexts
top_error_patterns.description: Numbers below ten are often written as numerals in narrative or explanatory text, which is discouraged in formal Spanish writing outside of mathematical expressions. They should be written out in words for style consistency.

examples.wrong: Por ejemplo, imagina un círculo (como una pizza) dividido en 4 partes iguales.
examples.correct: Por ejemplo, imagina un círculo (como una pizza) dividido en cuatro partes iguales.

examples.wrong: Si un pastel se corta en 8 partes y comes 3, la fracción es 3/8.
examples.correct: Si un pastel se corta en ocho partes y comes tres, la fracción es 3/8.

top_error_patterns.description: List items following a colon are often capitalized, which is not standard in Spanish unless the item is a proper noun or starts a new sentence. Lowercase should be used for naturalness and consistency.

examples.wrong: Booleano: Verdadero o falso.
examples.correct: Booleano: verdadero o falso.

examples.wrong: Flotante: Números con decimales.
examples.correct: Flotante: números con decimales.

top_error_patterns.description: Examples are introduced with 'Ejemplo:' as a standalone label, which is less natural in Spanish educational writing. 'Por ejemplo,' is preferred for smoother integration.

examples.wrong: Ejemplo: un estudiante que practica problemas matemáticos difíciles...
examples.correct: Por ejemplo, un estudiante que practica problemas matemáticos difíciles...

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-standard use of code formatting or accentuation
top_error_patterns.description: Use of backticks for code or missing accent marks in imperative forms, which are not standard in Spanish educational or instructional contexts.

examples.wrong: Inicio del juego: `monedasJugador = 0`
examples.correct: Inicio del juego: monedasJugador = 0
examples.context: Backticks used to enclose variable assignment.

examples.wrong: Fijarse en las primeras y últimas frases de los párrafos.
examples.correct: Fíjarse en las primeras y últimas frases de los párrafos.
examples.context: Missing accent mark in imperative verb form.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of direct English terms, literal translations, or non-standard Polish terminology that reduces clarity and educational fit for Polish learners.

examples.wrong: Integer
examples.correct: Liczba całkowita
examples.context: Programming/data type terminology in educational content

examples.wrong: Gałąź ustawodawcza
examples.correct: Władza ustawodawcza

examples.wrong: Planer
examples.correct: Kalendarz

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect noun case and gender agreement
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent errors in matching noun case and gender with adjectives, pronouns, or prepositions, leading to confusion and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: W tym lekcji dowiesz się...
examples.correct: W tej lekcji dowiesz się...
examples.context: Prepositional phrase with incorrect gender agreement for 'lekcja' (feminine noun).

examples.wrong: Obywatele muszą się zarejestrować, aby potwierdzić swoją uprawnienia...
examples.correct: Obywatele muszą się zarejestrować, aby potwierdzić swoje uprawnienia...
examples.context: Possessive pronoun does not agree in case and number with the plural noun.

examples.wrong: Czaszki i nagietki symbolizują pamięć oraz świętowanie ukochanych, którzy odeszli.
examples.correct: Czaszki i nagietki symbolizują pamięć oraz świętowanie ukochanych osób, które odeszły.
examples.context: Relative clause and noun require agreement in gender and number.

top_error_patterns.description: Systematic misuse of prepositions or cases, especially in set phrases, leading to unnatural or incorrect expressions.

examples.wrong: Każdej akcji odpowiada reakcja o tej samej sile, lecz przeciwnym kierunku
examples.correct: Każdej akcji odpowiada reakcja o tej samej sile, lecz w przeciwnym kierunku

examples.wrong: woda zamarza w lód
examples.correct: woda zamarza na lód
examples.context: Incorrect preposition 'w' instead of 'na' for transformation.

examples.wrong: AI o samoświadomości
examples.correct: AI ze samoświadomością
examples.context: Incorrect preposition 'o' instead of 'ze' with instrumental case.

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences lacking a main verb or subject, resulting in fragments that reduce clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: Białka przeciwzamrożeniowe u ryb arktycznych zapobiegające tworzeniu się kryształów lodu we krwi.
examples.correct: Białka przeciwzamrożeniowe u ryb arktycznych zapobiegają tworzeniu się kryształów lodu we krwi.
examples.context: Missing main verb; sentence is a fragment.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard or incorrect terms that are not recognized in educational or professional contexts, causing confusion.

examples.wrong: Równania jednoruchowe
examples.correct: Równania jednomianowe

top_error_patterns.description: Omission of required Polish diacritics, resulting in misspelled words and reduced professionalism.

examples.wrong: haslo123
examples.correct: hasło123

top_error_patterns.description: Mathematical examples use phrasing or logic that does not match Polish educational standards, leading to confusion or misinterpretation.

examples.wrong: każda osoba otrzymuje 1/4 cukierków
examples.correct: każda osoba otrzymuje 4 cukierki
examples.context: Division of items among people in math problems

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect case usage in historical terminology
top_error_patterns.description: Failure to apply correct grammatical case to historical terms, resulting in unnatural or incorrect Polish phrasing.

examples.wrong: szczególnie Holokaust
examples.correct: szczególnie Holokaustu
examples.context: References to historical events in educational content

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Use of non-Polish mnemonics and acronyms
top_error_patterns.description: English mnemonics or acronyms are used instead of culturally relevant Polish equivalents, reducing relatability and comprehension.

examples.wrong: akronim "ROYGBIV" dla kolorów tęczy
examples.correct: akronim "KGBINFS" dla kolorów tęczy po polsku

top_error_patterns.description: Direct translation of literary terms from English leads to non-standard or unnatural Polish terminology.

examples.wrong: Wolny wiersz
examples.correct: Wiersz wolny
examples.context: Literary genre names in quiz content

top_error_patterns.description: Direct translations from English result in unnatural or awkward phrasing in Polish, reducing clarity and fluency. Corrections use more idiomatic Polish expressions.

examples.wrong: To jest szansa na poprawę.
examples.correct: To okazja do poprawy.

examples.wrong: Wyobraź sobie, że wybierasz między trzema laptopami.
examples.correct: Wyobraź sobie, że wybierasz spośród trzech laptopów.

examples.wrong: Używaj symboli, podkreśleń lub kolorowego kodowania, aby wyróżnić istotne punkty.
examples.correct: Używaj symboli, podkreśleń lub kolorów, aby wyróżnić istotne punkty.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural Mismatch in Examples and References
top_error_patterns.description: Use of US-specific or foreign cultural references, examples, or models that are unfamiliar or irrelevant to Polish learners, reducing relatability and comprehension.

examples.wrong: Model "MyPlate": Wizualny przewodnik stworzony przez USDA...
examples.correct: Model talerza: Wizualny przewodnik pokazujący, jak zrównoważyć posiłek...
examples.context: Nutrition education; US-centric model replaced with neutral/local equivalent

examples.wrong: Partia Demokratyczna czy Republikańska
examples.correct: Platforma Obywatelska czy Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
examples.context: Political party examples in Polish civic context

examples.wrong: Kawałek pizzy ma kształt trójkąta.
examples.correct: Kawałek ciasta ma kształt trójkąta.

examples.wrong: Choroby genetyczne, takie jak anemia sierpowata czy mukowiscydoza...
examples.correct: Choroby genetyczne, takie jak dystrofia mięśniowa Duchenne’a czy fenyloketonuria...

examples.wrong: Społeczność decyduje się na budowę tamy dla magazynowania wody.
examples.correct: Społeczność decyduje się na budowę zbiornika wodnego.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Overuse of Emojis in Formal Educational Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as 🌟, 🌍, 📚, 😊 are frequently used in introductions and conclusions, which undermines the professional and formal tone expected in Polish educational materials.

examples.wrong: Przygotuj się na fascynującą podróż przez narzędzia i techniki, które uczynią Cię bardziej świadomym konsumentem informacji! 📚
examples.correct: Przygotuj się na poznanie narzędzi i technik, które pomogą Ci stać się bardziej świadomym odbiorcą informacji.

examples.wrong: Są one uniwersalne, co oznacza, że dotyczą każdego, wszędzie, i są uznawane za nieodłączne dla wszystkich ludzi. 🌍
examples.correct: Są one uniwersalne, co oznacza, że dotyczą każdego, wszędzie, i są uznawane za nieodłączne dla wszystkich ludzi.

examples.wrong: W tej lekcji poznamy sześć typów maszyn prostych i dowiemy się, jak pomagają nam w codziennym życiu! 😊
examples.correct: W tej lekcji poznamy sześć typów maszyn prostych i dowiemy się, jak pomagają nam w codziennym życiu!

top_error_patterns.description: Non-standard, ambiguous, or outdated terms are used instead of established Polish terminology, affecting clarity and professional tone.

examples.wrong: symulacje cyfrowe
examples.correct: symulacje komputerowe

examples.wrong: Moc obliczeniowa
examples.correct: Wydajność obliczeniowa

examples.wrong: książki naukowe
examples.correct: książki popularnonaukowe

top_error_patterns.description: Use of literal translations, false friends, or nonstandard terms that do not align with Polish educational or scientific conventions, leading to confusion or reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: ćmy pieprzowe
examples.correct: ćmy / krępak brzozowy
examples.context: Biology/science content; 'peppered moths' translated too literally.

examples.wrong: neony
examples.correct: lampy neonowe
examples.context: Physics; 'neony' refers to signs, not plasma devices.

examples.wrong: umiejętności nauki
examples.correct: umiejętności uczenia się

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Stylistically awkward or less idiomatic phrasing
top_error_patterns.description: Phrases are grammatically correct but use constructions that are less natural or idiomatic in Polish, affecting clarity and professional tone.

examples.wrong: Nasz napój zawiera kofeinę, więc pomoże Ci być produktywnym.
examples.correct: Nasz napój zawiera kofeinę, więc pomoże Ci zwiększyć produktywność.
examples.context: Instructional content; more idiomatic verb phrase preferred.

examples.wrong: Wiem, jak bardzo chciałeś być w tej drużynie.
examples.correct: Wiem, jak bardzo chciałeś dołączyć do tej drużyny.
examples.context: Expressing desire to join a group; more natural verb choice.

examples.wrong: Pisz własnymi słowami, aby poprawić zrozumienie.
examples.correct: Pisz własnymi słowami, aby lepiej zrozumieć materiał.
examples.context: Educational instruction; idiomatic expression for comprehension.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect case usage and noun/adjective agreement
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent errors in noun case selection and adjective-noun agreement, resulting in unnatural or incorrect grammatical constructions.

examples.wrong: bojkocie autobusowym w Montgomery
examples.correct: bojkocie autobusów w Montgomery
examples.context: History; incorrect adjective instead of noun in locative case.

examples.wrong: wokół jej podwórka
examples.correct: wokół jej podwórza

top_error_patterns.description: Use of English-derived words or direct borrowings that are not standard in Polish, leading to unnatural phrasing and reduced professionalism.

examples.wrong: Finalizuj projekt na podstawie wyników testów.
examples.correct: Sfinalizuj projekt na podstawie wyników testów.

examples.wrong: Fascynujące narzędzie technologiczne
examples.correct: Zaawansowane narzędzie technologiczne
examples.context: Descriptive adjectives; subjective language replaced with neutral

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnatural word order and aspect choice
top_error_patterns.description: Use of English-influenced word order or incorrect verb aspect, making sentences sound unnatural or ambiguous in Polish.

examples.wrong: pisanie wyimaginowane
examples.correct: wyimaginowane pisanie

examples.wrong: aby unikać wdychania dymu
examples.correct: aby uniknąć wdychania dymu
examples.context: Instruction; perfective aspect needed for specific action.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that do not match Polish scientific or educational standards, leading to misunderstanding or lack of professionalism.

examples.wrong: elementy
examples.correct: pierwiastki

examples.wrong: produktywność
examples.correct: wydajność
examples.context: Education; 'wydajność' is preferred for cognitive efficiency.

top_error_patterns.description: Literal translations or non-standard collocations that sound unnatural in Polish, affecting clarity and fluency.

examples.wrong: taniec samba
examples.correct: taniec samby
examples.context: Describing dance types; genitive case required

examples.wrong: część pizzy
examples.correct: kawałek pizzy

top_error_patterns.description: Redundant use of the same word or concept within a sentence, reducing clarity and stylistic quality.

examples.wrong: Uprzedzenie to preferencja lub uprzedzenie wpływające na sposób prezentacji informacji.
examples.correct: Uprzedzenie to preferencja lub stronniczość wpływająca na sposób prezentacji informacji.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inaccurate Official Titles and Administrative Terms
top_error_patterns.description: Use of incorrect titles or administrative terms that do not match Polish official nomenclature, causing confusion in context.

examples.wrong: burmistrz (Warszawa)
examples.correct: prezydent miasta (Warszawa)

examples.wrong: stan
examples.correct: województwo
examples.context: Regional divisions; Poland uses provinces, not states

top_error_patterns.description: Formatting conventions (dates, fractions, capitalization) do not follow Polish standards, affecting professionalism and readability.

examples.wrong: 1/2 szklanki cukru
examples.correct: ½ szklanki cukru

examples.wrong: Lata 2020
examples.correct: lata 20. XXI wieku

examples.wrong: Festiwal Świateł
examples.correct: Festiwal świateł

top_error_patterns.description: Adjectives or modifiers placed after nouns where Polish prefers pre-nominal position, reducing naturalness and flow.

examples.wrong: Przeprowadź badania wstępne
examples.correct: Przeprowadź wstępne badania
examples.context: Instructional phrase; adjective should precede noun.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Use of 'i' instead of 'oraz' in formal lists
top_error_patterns.description: The conjunction 'i' is used to join items in lists where 'oraz' is preferred for register consistency in educational or technical contexts.

examples.wrong: Nauka zarządzania emocjami pozwala reagować spokojnie i podejmować przemyślane decyzje.
examples.correct: Nauka zarządzania emocjami pozwala reagować spokojnie oraz podejmować przemyślane decyzje.
examples.context: Listing related actions in educational content.

examples.wrong: Wyłonił się w latach 50., ewoluując z rhythm and bluesa i muzyki country.
examples.correct: Wyłonił się w latach 50., ewoluując z rhythm and bluesa oraz muzyki country.
examples.context: Listing musical genres in technical description.

top_error_patterns.description: Possessive pronouns are used where context already makes ownership clear, leading to unnecessary repetition and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: z akceptacją swojej nowej tożsamości jako czarodzieja
examples.correct: z akceptacją nowej tożsamości jako czarodzieja
examples.context: Describing internal conflict; possessive is redundant.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Orthographic issues with punctuation and loanwords
top_error_patterns.description: Non-standard punctuation (e.g., English-style em dash, apostrophe in loanwords) and minor spelling inconsistencies that do not impede comprehension but affect professional presentation.

examples.wrong: Myślę, że źle się zrozumieliśmy—czy możemy porozmawiać o tym, co się stało?
examples.correct: Myślę, że źle się zrozumieliśmy – czy możemy porozmawiać o tym, co się stało?
examples.context: Clause separation; Polish prefers spaced en dash.

examples.wrong: ragtime’u
examples.correct: ragtime'u
examples.context: Genitive form of loanword; apostrophe usage.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect Terminology Due to English Calques
top_error_patterns.description: English terms or calques are used instead of standard French terminology, leading to unnatural or incorrect expressions in French educational content.

examples.wrong: Le Président la veto
examples.correct: Le Président oppose son veto
examples.context: Political terminology; direct translation from English instead of idiomatic French.

examples.wrong: fulcrum
examples.correct: point d'appui
examples.context: Scientific terminology; English word used instead of the French equivalent.

examples.wrong: w/ pour "avec"
examples.correct: av. pour "avec"
examples.context: Abbreviations; English shortcut used in French note-taking advice.

top_error_patterns.description: Questions are frequently formed using direct translation from English, resulting in incorrect word order and missing inversion, which reduces clarity and professionalism in French educational content.

examples.wrong: Pourquoi reconnaître les biais est important ?
examples.correct: Pourquoi est-il important de reconnaître les biais ?
examples.context: Quiz questions; formal written French requires verb-subject inversion for clarity.

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences are often incomplete, missing a main verb or subject, which leads to fragments that are unclear and grammatically incorrect in French.

examples.wrong: De petits choix comme ce que manger au petit déjeuner, à des décisions plus importantes comme choisir une activité après l'école.
examples.correct: De petits choix comme ce que vous allez manger au petit déjeuner, à des décisions plus importantes comme le choix d'une activité après l'école.
examples.context: Explanatory text; fragments reduce clarity and disrupt reading flow.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent misuse of articles and gender agreement, especially with abstract nouns and prepositional phrases, leading to ungrammatical and unnatural French expressions.

examples.wrong: Les conflits peuvent être résolus grâce à la calme, l'écoute et les compromis.
examples.correct: Les conflits peuvent être résolus grâce au calme, à l'écoute et aux compromis.
examples.context: List of abstract concepts; incorrect articles and gender disrupt grammatical correctness.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural Mismatches in Mnemonics and Acronyms
top_error_patterns.description: English mnemonics or acronyms are used without adaptation, reducing comprehension and cultural relevance for French learners.

examples.wrong: "ROYGBIV" représente les couleurs de l'arc-en-ciel
examples.correct: "VIBJOR" représente les couleurs de l'arc-en-ciel
examples.context: Mnemonic for rainbow colors; English acronym used instead of French convention.

top_error_patterns.description: Gender agreement errors in French terminology, affecting grammatical correctness and professionalism.

examples.wrong: un planète
examples.correct: une planète
examples.context: Use of articles with nouns; impacts clarity and correctness in educational content.

top_error_patterns.description: Factual details are localized incorrectly, reflecting information from another culture (e.g., US) instead of French standards.

examples.wrong: tous les quatre ans pour les élections présidentielles
examples.correct: tous les cinq ans pour les élections présidentielles
examples.context: Election frequency; US system referenced instead of French reality.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of literal translations, anglicisms, or non-standard terms instead of accepted French terminology in educational, scientific, and cultural contexts.

examples.wrong: Coût total = 2x
examples.correct: C = 2x

examples.wrong: brainstorming en groupe
examples.correct: remue-méninges en groupe

examples.wrong: bulletin par courrier
examples.correct: vote par correspondance

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that are technically correct but not idiomatic or standard in French educational contexts, such as 'fourrure' instead of 'pelage', 'motifs rangoli' instead of 'motifs de rangoli', or 'comptage de syllabes' instead of 'nombre de syllabes'.

examples.wrong: Lièvre variable : Fourrure blanche en hiver pour se camoufler dans la neige.
examples.correct: Lièvre variable : Pelage blanc en hiver pour se camoufler dans la neige.

examples.wrong: motifs rangoli
examples.correct: motifs de rangoli

examples.wrong: La poésie en vers libres ne suit pas de schéma de rimes, de mètre ou de comptage de syllabes spécifique.
examples.correct: La poésie en vers libres ne suit pas de schéma de rimes, de mètre ou de nombre de syllabes spécifique.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-standard use of emojis in educational content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis (🌍, 🌟, 🚀, 🎨, 📏, 🍕, 📐, ✨, 🥦, 🍎) are frequently used at the end of sentences or introductions, which is not standard in formal French educational materials. Their presence can reduce professionalism and distract from the instructional tone.

examples.wrong: Préparez-vous à plonger dans les mystères de notre atmosphère et de nos océans ! 🌍
examples.correct: Préparez-vous à explorer les phénomènes de notre atmosphère et de nos océans !

examples.wrong: Dans cette leçon, nous allons découvrir leur origine, leur importance, et comment ils influencent nos vies et nos sociétés 🌍.
examples.correct: Dans cette leçon, nous allons découvrir leur origine, leur importance, et comment ils influencent nos vies et nos sociétés.

examples.wrong: Bienvenue dans le monde fascinant de la géométrie ! ... est lié à ces concepts fondamentaux. 🎨📐
examples.correct: Bienvenue dans le monde fascinant de la géométrie ! ... est lié à ces concepts fondamentaux.

top_error_patterns.description: Direct translation of English expressions or sentence structures that result in unnatural or awkward French phrasing, reducing clarity and engagement.

examples.wrong: Pensez aux nucléotides comme des perles sur un fil qui forment un collier
examples.correct: Imaginez les nucléotides comme des perles enfilées sur un fil, formant un collier

examples.wrong: Complimenter quelqu’un pour son travail acharné.
examples.correct: Féliciter quelqu’un pour son travail acharné.

examples.wrong: En pratiquant ces compétences, les élèves peuvent développer des amitiés significatives
examples.correct: En pratiquant ces compétences, les élèves peuvent développer des amitiés solides

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-standard formatting for book titles and historical dates
top_error_patterns.description: Book titles are formatted with English quotation marks (" ") instead of French guillemets (« »), and centuries are written with Arabic numerals and 'ème' instead of Roman numerals and 'e' (e.g., '7ème siècle' instead of 'VIIe siècle').

examples.wrong: Dans "Le Petit Prince" de Saint-Exupéry...
examples.correct: Dans « Le Petit Prince » de Saint-Exupéry...

examples.wrong: 7ème siècle de notre ère
examples.correct: VIIe siècle de notre ère

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect typographic conventions for percent sign
top_error_patterns.description: A non-breaking space is often missing before the percent sign (%), which is required by French typographic standards.

examples.wrong: Probabilité = 1/6 ≈ 0,167 ou 16,7 %
examples.correct: Probabilité = 1/6 ≈ 0,167 ou 16,7 %

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect use of comma before 'et' in enumerations
top_error_patterns.description: A comma is often incorrectly placed before 'et' in lists, reflecting English influence. French punctuation rules do not require a comma before 'et' in enumerations.

examples.wrong: La gentillesse est une qualité qui consiste à être attentionné, prévenant, et utile envers les autres.
examples.correct: La gentillesse est une qualité qui consiste à être attentionné, prévenant et utile envers les autres.

examples.wrong: En comprenant les dangers, en prévenant les incendies, et en sachant comment réagir en cas d'urgence...
examples.correct: En comprenant les dangers, en prévenant les incendies et en sachant comment réagir en cas d'urgence...

examples.wrong: La gentillesse est bien plus que simplement être gentil—c’est une manière d’exprimer l’empathie, le respect, et de poser des actions positives...
examples.correct: La gentillesse est bien plus que simplement être gentil — c’est une manière d’exprimer l’empathie, le respect et de poser des actions positives...

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural Inaccuracy or Lack of Localization
top_error_patterns.description: Omission of French cultural equivalents, use of unfamiliar mnemonics, or lack of adaptation to local context, which may hinder learner comprehension or inclusivity.

examples.wrong: Thanksgiving aux États-Unis
examples.correct: Thanksgiving aux États-Unis (Action de grâce au Canada)

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or Inconsistent Use of French Educational Conventions
top_error_patterns.description: Failure to follow French conventions for formatting, variable naming, or instructional style, leading to confusion or lack of professionalism.

examples.correct: Une droite : ↔

examples.correct: Normes NGSS HS-ETS1-4

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect use of relative clauses and participles
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent misuse of participles or omission of relative pronouns, leading to unnatural or ambiguous sentence structure. Proper French requires relative clauses for clarity.

examples.wrong: Bosses stockant de la graisse pour survivre sans nourriture longtemps.
examples.correct: Bosses qui stockent de la graisse pour survivre longtemps sans nourriture.
examples.context: Describing features or actions of a subject.

examples.wrong: Vous survolez en lisant les titres des sections...
examples.correct: Vous survolez le texte en lisant les titres des sections...

examples.wrong: pour se rappeler Mercure, Vénus, Terre, Mars...
examples.correct: pour se souvenir de Mercure, Vénus, Terre, Mars...

top_error_patterns.description: Use of English loanwords or calques where standard French equivalents exist, reducing clarity and professional tone in educational contexts.

examples.wrong: Interviews avec des parties prenantes
examples.correct: Entretiens avec des parties prenantes

examples.wrong: mindset de croissance
examples.correct: état d'esprit de croissance

examples.wrong: volant
examples.correct: roue de voiture

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Missing or incorrect use of articles in lists
top_error_patterns.description: Articles are sometimes omitted or inconsistently used when listing multiple nouns, leading to ungrammatical or unclear phrasing.

examples.wrong: L'art, riche en symbolisme, reflétait leur culture et leurs croyances dans des fresques et sculptures.
examples.correct: L'art, riche en symbolisme, reflétait leur culture et leurs croyances dans des fresques et des sculptures.

examples.wrong: Textes sacrés : Les Védas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita et Ramayana.
examples.correct: Textes sacrés : les Védas, les Upanishads, la Bhagavad Gita et le Ramayana.

top_error_patterns.description: Statements that overgeneralize scientific facts or use imprecise terminology, potentially misleading learners.

examples.wrong: Les non-métaux sont cassants et isolants
examples.correct: Les non-métaux sont généralement cassants et isolants

examples.wrong: thérapie génique pour corriger des ADN défectueux
examples.correct: thérapie génique pour corriger des gènes défectueux

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that are technically correct but contextually inappropriate for abstract or educational concepts, leading to confusion.

examples.wrong: Les quatre composants de l'intelligence émotionnelle
examples.correct: Les quatre composantes de l'intelligence émotionnelle

examples.wrong: Un état haute énergie où les particules sont ionisées (chargées).
examples.correct: Un état de haute énergie où les particules sont ionisées (chargées).

top_error_patterns.description: Negative sentences constructed with incorrect conjunctions or word order, resulting in awkward or unclear phrasing.

examples.wrong: Ne cliquez jamais sur des liens suspects ni ne téléchargez de pièces jointes...
examples.correct: Ne cliquez jamais sur des liens suspects et ne téléchargez pas de pièces jointes...

examples.wrong: La panique rend les décisions sûres plus difficiles.
examples.correct: La panique rend la prise de décisions sûres plus difficile.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that are ambiguous or culturally inappropriate, leading to confusion between similar concepts (e.g., holidays).

examples.wrong: Fêtes principales : Pâque (commémoration de l'Exode d'Égypte)...
examples.correct: Fêtes principales : Pessa'h (commémoration de l'Exode d'Égypte)...

examples.wrong: Si la personne ne reprend pas conscience en une à deux minutes...
examples.correct: Si la personne ne reprend pas conscience au bout d'une à deux minutes...

top_error_patterns.description: Phrasing that is grammatically correct but less idiomatic or formal in French educational contexts, such as 'comme' instead of 'tels que', 'deuxième' instead of 'second', or elliptical sentences lacking a subject.

examples.wrong: Les animaux vivent dans des environnements variés, comme l'Arctique glacé ou le désert aride.
examples.correct: Les animaux vivent dans des environnements variés, tels que l'Arctique glacé ou le désert aride.

examples.wrong: Moins cher, donc plus accessible.
examples.correct: C'est moins cher, donc plus accessible.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Use of English loanwords or calques in formal contexts
top_error_patterns.description: English loanwords (e.g., 'brainstorming') or calques (e.g., 'phrases en "je"') are used where more idiomatic French alternatives exist, reducing the naturalness and professionalism of the content.

examples.wrong: Brainstorming de solutions
examples.correct: Génération d'idées de solutions

examples.wrong: Utilisez des phrases en "je" pour expliquer vos sentiments
examples.correct: Utilisez des phrases commençant par "je" pour expliquer vos sentiments

top_error_patterns.description: English quotation marks (" ") are used instead of French guillemets (« »), which is not compliant with French typographic norms.

examples.wrong: vous recherchez rapidement l'année "1789" sans lire chaque mot.
examples.correct: vous recherchez rapidement l'année « 1789 » sans lire chaque mot.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect contraction before proper names starting with a vowel
top_error_patterns.description: The contraction 'de' + vowel is sometimes not applied, leading to hiatus and non-standard written French.

examples.wrong: "Le Petit Prince" de Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
examples.correct: "Le Petit Prince" d'Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent mistakes in matching gender and case between nouns, adjectives, and verbs, leading to ungrammatical and unclear sentences.

examples.wrong: Река Нил обеспечивал водой...
examples.correct: Река Нил обеспечивала водой...
examples.context: Verb does not agree in gender with the feminine noun 'река'.

examples.wrong: В ночной переполох,
examples.correct: В ночном переполохе,
examples.context: Adjective and noun do not agree in case and gender after the preposition.

examples.wrong: Эксперименты проводятся для проверки гипотезы путем изменения одного переменного...
examples.correct: Эксперименты проводятся для проверки гипотезы путем изменения одной переменной...
examples.context: Numeral and noun do not agree in gender and case.

examples.wrong: Сильный ритм и звучание, основанное на гитаре.
examples.correct: Сильный ритм и звучание, основанные на гитаре.
examples.context: Participle does not agree in number with compound subject.

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect use of prepositional case after prepositions, resulting in grammatical errors and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: Физические адаптации... связаны с средой обитания.
examples.correct: Физические адаптации... связаны со средой обитания.
examples.context: Preposition 'с' should be 'со' before consonant cluster for euphony and correct case.

examples.wrong: Берёт начало... с развитием в эпохи Ренессанса...
examples.correct: Берёт начало... с развитием в эпохах Ренессанса...
examples.context: Prepositional plural required after 'в' when referring to multiple eras.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of participial phrases that are syntactically awkward or ungrammatical, affecting sentence flow and comprehension.

examples.wrong: Тянув вниз за веревку, вы облегчаете подъем объекта вверх.
examples.correct: Тянув верёвку вниз, вы облегчаете подъём объекта вверх.
examples.context: Participial phrase is not idiomatic and misplaces adverb; corrected for natural Russian syntax.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Culturally Inaccurate Terminology for Historical Events
top_error_patterns.description: Use of generic or non-standard terms for culturally specific historical events leads to misrepresentation and confusion in the target language.

examples.wrong: Гражданское движение за права человека было переломным моментом в истории США.
examples.correct: Гражданское движение за права афроамериканцев было переломным моментом в истории США.
examples.context: Refers to the US Civil Rights Movement; the original term is too broad and not culturally precise in Russian.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission of Key Cultural or Factual Elements in Mnemonics
top_error_patterns.description: Localized mnemonics or examples omit essential elements, resulting in factual inaccuracies and reduced educational clarity.

examples.wrong: акроним "МОЭС" помогает запомнить названия Великих озёр: Мичиган, Онтарио, Эри, Супериор.
examples.correct: акроним "МОЭС" помогает запомнить названия Великих озёр: Мичиган, Онтарио, Эри, Супериор, Гурон.
examples.context: The mnemonic for the Great Lakes omits 'Гурон', leading to incomplete and misleading information.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that are literal translations or not standard in Russian educational, scientific, or professional contexts, leading to confusion or lack of clarity.

examples.wrong: эндоплазматическая сеть
examples.correct: эндоплазматический ретикулум

examples.correct: гвоздодёр

examples.correct: Документальная литература — это вид литературы...

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect grammatical case, agreement, or verb tense
top_error_patterns.description: Systematic errors in case usage, verb tense, and agreement, leading to awkward or incorrect phrasing and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: Принятие решений часто связано с сложными ситуациями
examples.correct: Принятие решений часто связано со сложными ситуациями

examples.wrong: если вы подбрасываете монету, вероятность выпасть «орлу»
examples.correct: если вы подбрасываете монету, вероятность выпадения «орла»

examples.wrong: если вы подбрасываете монету 10 раз и «орел» выпадает 6 раз
examples.correct: если вы подбрасываете монету 10 раз и «орел» выпал 6 раз

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or inconsistent use of 'ё' vs 'е'
top_error_patterns.description: Words that should be spelled with 'ё' are often written with 'е', which can cause ambiguity and pronunciation errors, especially in educational and scientific contexts.

examples.wrong: объем
examples.correct: объём

examples.wrong: подчеркивая
examples.correct: подчёркивая

examples.wrong: вооруженными силами
examples.correct: Вооружёнными Силами

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural misfit or lack of localization
top_error_patterns.description: Examples, phrases, or references that do not align with Russian cultural norms, educational practices, or everyday realities, reducing relatability and engagement.

examples.wrong: Создайте тихое место для учебы.
examples.correct: Организуйте удобное и спокойное пространство для учебы.

examples.wrong: Празднование фестивалей, таких как Дивали и Холи.
examples.correct: Празднование праздников, таких как Дивали и Холи.

examples.wrong: Прокламация об освобождении рабов, изданная Авраамом Линкольном во время гражданской войны.
examples.correct: Прокламация об освобождении рабов, подписанная Авраамом Линкольном во время Гражданской войны в США.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of phrases, word choices, or sentence structures that are technically correct but sound awkward, stilted, or less idiomatic in Russian, affecting readability and professionalism.

examples.wrong: Ведите дневник для фиксации мыслей и чувств.
examples.correct: Ведите дневник для записи мыслей и чувств.

examples.wrong: Он обеспечивает логичность, повторяемость и доказательность исследований.
examples.correct: Он обеспечивает логичность, воспроизводимость и обоснованность исследований.

examples.wrong: Избегание сладких закусок помогает оставаться сосредоточенным и энергичным.
examples.correct: Отказ от сладких перекусов помогает сохранять концентрацию и энергию.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-idiomatic lexical choices (calques and unnatural collocations)
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of literal translations or non-standard collocations that do not match Russian educational or scientific style, reducing clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: дом для разнообразных растений и животных
examples.correct: место обитания разнообразных растений и животных

examples.correct: годовой бойкот

examples.correct: эмоционально сопереживать сюжету

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Orthographic errors: incorrect spelling, word formation, and use of ё
top_error_patterns.description: Misspellings, incorrect word formation (e.g., negative particle separation), and omission of ё where required, affecting clarity and educational accuracy.

examples.wrong: не прилипающую повязку
examples.correct: неприлипающую повязку
examples.context: Negative participle spelling in medical context

examples.wrong: Твердые тела имеют фиксированную форму и объем
examples.correct: Твёрдые тела имеют фиксированную форму и объём

examples.wrong: булевы значения
examples.correct: булевые значения

top_error_patterns.description: Use of examples, formatting, or conventions (such as phone numbers or menu items) that do not match Russian standards, causing confusion or reducing authenticity.

examples.wrong: Гриль-курица (белок)
examples.correct: Курица-гриль (белок)

top_error_patterns.description: Omission of nouns after adjectives or use of plural/singular forms that create ambiguity, reducing clarity and precision.

examples.wrong: Пенопластовая изоляция сохраняла воду холодной на 3 часа дольше, чем пластиковая.
examples.correct: Пенопластовая изоляция сохраняла воду холодной на 3 часа дольше, чем пластиковая изоляция.

examples.wrong: уменьшение размера классов
examples.correct: уменьшение размера класса
examples.context: Genitive singular vs. plural in educational context

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-standard terminology in technical and educational contexts
top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard or awkward terms for technical concepts, reducing professionalism and localization fit.

examples.wrong: Экологический ученый
examples.correct: Эколог

examples.correct: двигатели ракет, обеспечивающие необходимую силу тяги

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-idiomatic or unnatural phrasing in educational style
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of literal translations, ambiguous constructions, or less idiomatic phrases that reduce clarity and naturalness in Russian educational texts.

examples.wrong: Дробь представляет часть целого.
examples.correct: Дробь — это часть целого.
