examples.wrong: Практикуйте эти техники, рисуя повседневные предметы, такие как кружка, ваза или дерево.
examples.correct: Практикуйте эти техники, рисуя повседневные предметы, например кружку, вазу или дерево.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inconsistent or non-standard terminology and transliteration
top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that are either literal translations, uncommon in Russian educational/scientific contexts, or transliterations without the original term in parentheses, reducing clarity and professional tone.

examples.wrong: ледерхозен
examples.correct: ледерхозен (Lederhosen)

examples.wrong: школьными принадлежностями
examples.correct: канцелярскими принадлежностями

examples.wrong: Ментальные карты
examples.correct: Интеллект-карты

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-standard or inappropriate use of emojis in educational content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as 🌟, 😊, 😄, and 🌍 are frequently used in introductions or explanations, but are not standard in Russian educational materials and may undermine professional tone or distract learners.

examples.wrong: Добро пожаловать в мир алгебры! 🌟
examples.correct: Добро пожаловать в мир алгебры!

examples.wrong: Готовы начать? 😄
examples.correct: Готовы начать?

examples.wrong: 🌍 Сегодня мы начнем изучение Всеобщей декларации прав человека...
examples.correct: Сегодня мы начнем изучение Всеобщей декларации прав человека...
examples.context: Introduction to a social studies topic

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or non-standard Russian quotation marks and formatting
top_error_patterns.description: Use of English-style quotes (") instead of Russian (« »), incorrect spacing in dates, numbers, and units, and other minor typographic inconsistencies that affect professional presentation.

examples.correct: например «password» или «123456»

examples.correct: пандусы для маломобильных граждан

top_error_patterns.description: Terms are used in a way that is technically correct but not the most precise or standard in Russian educational or scientific discourse, which can affect clarity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: энергетическая станция
examples.correct: энергетическая станция клетки

examples.correct: засохших растений

top_error_patterns.description: Words are incorrectly capitalized or not capitalized according to Russian orthographic standards, affecting the professional tone and consistency.

examples.wrong: Неделя празднования африканского наследия
examples.correct: неделя празднования африканского наследия
examples.context: General nouns not at sentence start

examples.correct: Интернет

examples.correct: Священного писания

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission or misuse of copula 'это' after dash
top_error_patterns.description: The particle 'это' is sometimes unnecessarily added after a dash or omitted where it clarifies the subject-predicate relationship, affecting clarity and adherence to Russian academic style.

examples.wrong: Этос, пафос и логос — это основные инструменты...
examples.correct: Этос, пафос и логос — основные инструменты...

examples.wrong: Принятие решений — важный навык...
examples.correct: Принятие решений — это важный навык...

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of English terms, direct translations, or non-standard terminology instead of accepted German equivalents, reducing clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: Real-World-Beispiel
examples.correct: Praxisbeispiel
examples.context: Anglicism used instead of standard German term in educational context.

examples.wrong: LGBTQ+-Personen
examples.correct: LSBTIQ+-Personen
examples.context: English acronym used instead of culturally accepted German version.

examples.wrong: Heimlich-Manöver
examples.correct: Heimlich-Handgriff
examples.context: Non-standard term for first aid technique.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent mismatches between articles or pronouns and the grammatical gender of nouns, leading to confusion and reduced linguistic accuracy.

examples.wrong: das DNA
examples.correct: die DNA

examples.wrong: Der Handelsbilanz misst...
examples.correct: Die Handelsbilanz misst...

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Lexical errors due to false friends or anglicisms
top_error_patterns.description: Use of incorrect terms or direct translations from English that do not fit German scientific or cultural context, reducing clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: Physikalische Anpassungen
examples.correct: Physiologische Anpassungen
examples.context: Incorrect use of 'physikalisch' instead of 'physiologisch' for biological adaptations

examples.correct: Kaktuszaunkönig

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission or misuse of articles and case in complex noun phrases
top_error_patterns.description: Missing or incorrect definite articles and case endings in multi-part noun phrases, especially with historical periods or abstract nouns, leading to ambiguity.

examples.wrong: entwickelt während Mittelalter, Renaissance, Barock, Klassik und Romantik.

examples.correct: Mit dem Verständnis dieser Grundlagen habt ihr den ersten Schritt zum Programmieren getan!

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Use of Emojis in Formal Educational Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as 🌍, 🌟, 🧮, 🖊️, 🎲✨, and 🥧 are frequently used in educational materials, but are considered informal and unprofessional in German academic contexts. Their removal improves the tone and cultural appropriateness.

examples.wrong: Willkommen zu einer Reise in die Welt des Alten Ägypten! 🌍
examples.correct: Willkommen zu einer Reise in die Welt des Alten Ägypten!

examples.wrong: In dieser Lektion werden wir die sechs Haupttypen einfacher Maschinen kennenlernen und herausfinden, wie sie unseren Alltag erleichtern. 🌟
examples.correct: In dieser Lektion werden wir die sechs Haupttypen einfacher Maschinen kennenlernen und herausfinden, wie sie unseren Alltag erleichtern.

examples.wrong: Brüche helfen uns, Dinge gleichmäßig zu teilen und zu verstehen. 🥧
examples.correct: Brüche helfen uns, Dinge gleichmäßig zu teilen und zu verstehen.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of English terms, anglicisms, or non-standard German terminology without explanation or parenthetical translation. Corrections provide standard German terms or add clarifying parentheticals.

examples.wrong: Voting Rights Act von 1965
examples.correct: Voting Rights Act von 1965 (Gesetz über das Wahlrecht von 1965)

examples.wrong: Planer verwenden
examples.correct: Kalender oder Terminplaner verwenden

examples.correct: Roulette und Black Jack

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Literal Translation of Idioms and Metaphors
top_error_patterns.description: Direct translation of English idioms or metaphors leads to unnatural or unclear German expressions, affecting comprehension and cultural fit.

examples.wrong: Freundlichkeit ist wie ein magisches Werkzeug, das die Welt zu einem besseren Ort macht.
examples.correct: Freundlichkeit ist wie ein Zauber, der die Welt zu einem besseren Ort macht.
examples.context: Literal translation of 'magical tool' instead of natural German metaphor.

examples.wrong: Freundlichkeit wirkt wie ein Wellen-Effekt
examples.correct: Freundlichkeit wirkt wie eine Welle
examples.context: Direct translation of 'ripple effect' not idiomatic in German.

examples.wrong: Das Verständnis deiner eigenen Emotionen kann helfen, sie besser zu steuern.
examples.correct: Das Verständnis der eigenen Emotionen kann helfen, sie besser zu steuern.
examples.context: Use of informal register and literal phrasing.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Use of non-standard or imprecise terminology
top_error_patterns.description: Non-standard, imprecise, or English-influenced terms are used instead of established German terminology, affecting clarity and professional tone.

examples.wrong: Symbolschrift-System
examples.correct: Schriftsystem aus Symbolen

examples.wrong: Sample Space
examples.correct: Ergebnisraum

examples.wrong: Systemstörungen
examples.correct: Systemmanipulationen

top_error_patterns.description: Use of English terms, mnemonics, or references without explanation or localization, which may confuse German learners or reduce relatability.

examples.wrong: Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee (SNCC)
examples.correct: Student Nonviolent Coordinating Committee (SNCC, Studentischer Ausschuss für gewaltfreie Koordination)
examples.context: English acronym used without German explanation.

examples.wrong: Mit „HOMES“ die Großen Seen merken.
examples.correct: Mit einem Akronym wie „HOMES“ die Großen Seen merken.
examples.context: US-centric mnemonic not explained for German learners.

examples.wrong: Laut EPA-Daten reduziert Recycling die Abfallmenge auf Deponien um 30 %.
examples.correct: Laut Umweltbundesamt-Daten reduziert Recycling die Abfallmenge auf Deponien um 30 %.
examples.context: Reference to US institution instead of German equivalent.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of informal address, generic masculine forms, or inconsistent register, which reduces professionalism and inclusivity in educational content.

examples.wrong: Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie entwerfen einen Rucksack für Schüler.
examples.correct: Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie entwerfen einen Rucksack für Schülerinnen und Schüler.
examples.context: Generic masculine form instead of gender-inclusive language.

examples.wrong: Erkläre dein Experiment und deine Ergebnisse deinen Mitschülern.
examples.correct: Erkläre dein Experiment und deine Ergebnisse deinen Mitschülerinnen und Mitschülern.

examples.wrong: Lasst uns gemeinsam die faszinierende Struktur der DNA ... erkunden! 🧬
examples.correct: Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam die faszinierende Struktur der DNA ... erkunden! 🧬
examples.context: Informal plural imperative instead of formal register.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-standard or awkward compound noun formation
top_error_patterns.description: Compound nouns are incorrectly formed, either missing connecting letters or written as separate words, which is not standard in German orthography.

examples.wrong: Variable Zuweisung
examples.correct: Variablenzuweisung

examples.wrong: Geschichtelemente
examples.correct: Geschichtselemente

examples.wrong: Optionenbewertung
examples.correct: Bewertung von Optionen

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences contain grammatical errors such as incorrect case, unnatural verb choices, or awkward word order, reducing clarity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: Unser Produkt ist wissenschaftlich bewiesen wirksam!
examples.correct: Unser Produkt ist wissenschaftlich als wirksam bewiesen!

examples.wrong: Ein historischer Roman, der das Leben während des Bürgerkriegs imaginiert.
examples.correct: Ein historischer Roman, der das Leben während des Bürgerkriegs beschreibt.

examples.wrong: Internationalen Pakt über bürgerliche und politische Rechte
examples.correct: Internationaler Pakt über bürgerliche und politische Rechte

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Improper Hyphenation in Compound Nouns and Adjectives
top_error_patterns.description: Compound nouns and adjectives are sometimes written without the recommended hyphenation, which can reduce readability and clarity, especially in technical or educational contexts.

examples.wrong: Nicht erneuerbare Ressourcen
examples.correct: Nicht-erneuerbare Ressourcen
examples.context: Compound adjective before noun in scientific/educational text

examples.wrong: Hochgeschwindigkeitsabgase
examples.correct: Hochgeschwindigkeits-Abgase
examples.context: Technical compound noun in science context

examples.wrong: Geschichtelemente Einführung
examples.correct: Geschichtelemente-Einführung

examples.wrong: Schritt-für-Schritt-Prozess
examples.correct: Schritt-für-Schritt-Prozess
examples.context: Multi-part compound noun; correct usage, but pattern is relevant for teaching

examples.wrong: Pro-und-Kontra-Listen
examples.correct: Pro-und-Kontra-Listen
examples.context: Compound noun; correct usage, but capitalization and hyphenation are recurring points

top_error_patterns.description: Use of less precise or anglicized terms instead of standard or more natural German expressions, which can reduce clarity and professionalism in educational materials.

examples.wrong: Ein Butterbrot machen.
examples.correct: Ein Butterbrot zubereiten.
examples.context: Verb choice for food preparation in instructional context

examples.wrong: Standarddeck
examples.correct: Standardspielkarten-Deck
examples.context: Anglicism for playing cards in educational context

examples.wrong: gesellschaftliche Kommentare
examples.correct: gesellschaftliche Themen
examples.context: Imprecise term for social commentary in lyrics

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or non-idiomatic prepositional and pronoun usage
top_error_patterns.description: Prepositions or pronouns are used in a way that is grammatically correct but not idiomatic or natural in German, affecting comprehension.

examples.wrong: das ganze Jahr
examples.correct: das ganze Jahr über

examples.wrong: warum dies geschieht
examples.correct: warum das geschieht

top_error_patterns.description: Abbreviations like 'z. B.' are used instead of the full phrase 'zum Beispiel', and are sometimes missing required punctuation, which can affect clarity and formality in educational content.

examples.wrong: wie z. B. tiefes Atmen oder zusätzliche Vorbereitung.
examples.correct: wie zum Beispiel tiefes Atmen oder zusätzliche Vorbereitung.
examples.context: Abbreviation used in instructional context; full phrase preferred for clarity

examples.wrong: Es reagiert leicht mit anderen Elementen, z. B. um Kochsalz (Natriumchlorid) zu bilden.
examples.correct: Es reagiert leicht mit anderen Elementen, z. B., um Kochsalz (Natriumchlorid) zu bilden.
examples.context: Missing comma after abbreviation introducing subordinate clause

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect spelling of culturally specific terms
top_error_patterns.description: Culturally specific terms are misspelled due to influence from other languages, which can affect localization fit and learner understanding.

examples.wrong: Bar/Bat Mitzwa
examples.correct: Bar/Bat Mizwa

top_error_patterns.description: Formatting errors such as incorrect use of hyphens in compound nouns, improper scientific notation, or non-standard presentation of numbers and symbols. Corrections align with German orthographic and formatting conventions.

examples.wrong: CO2-Fußabdruck
examples.correct: CO₂-Fußabdruck

examples.wrong: Zwei-Drittel-Mehrheit
examples.correct: Zweidrittelmehrheit

examples.wrong: Notrufnummer wählen (112).
examples.correct: Notrufnummer 112 wählen.

top_error_patterns.description: References or examples lack local cultural relevance or context, or use phrasing that may be unclear to German learners. Corrections provide more locally resonant examples or clarify institutional references.

examples.wrong: Eine Biografie von Martin Luther King Jr.
examples.correct: Eine Biografie über Martin Luther King Jr.

examples.wrong: Im wegweisenden Fall *Brown v. Board of Education* entschied der Oberste Gerichtshof...
examples.correct: Im wegweisenden Fall *Brown v. Board of Education* entschied der Oberste Gerichtshof der Vereinigten Staaten...

top_error_patterns.description: Use of English-style punctuation (e.g., em dash) or non-standard typographic elements instead of German conventions, which can affect the professional tone.

examples.wrong: Ein Frosch springt hinein—
examples.correct: Ein Frosch springt hinein –
examples.context: Use of em dash instead of spaced en dash in narrative text

examples.wrong: Phantásien
examples.correct: Phantásien
examples.context: Non-standard accent in literary context; not an error but a recurring point for clarification

top_error_patterns.description: Ambiguous or less idiomatic grammatical constructions that could be clarified for better comprehension and naturalness.

examples.wrong: Wenn der Kongress ein Gesetz verabschiedet, muss es vom Präsidenten (Exekutive) genehmigt oder abgelehnt werden.
examples.correct: Wenn der Kongress ein Gesetz verabschiedet, muss es vom Präsidenten (der Exekutive) genehmigt oder abgelehnt werden.
examples.context: Ambiguous parenthetical reference in political context

examples.wrong: Er erwachte erschrocken,
examples.correct: Er erwachte erschrocken auf,
examples.context: Missing separable verb particle for idiomatic expression

top_error_patterns.description: Use of English or US formatting conventions (e.g., phone numbers) instead of German standards, which may cause confusion or reduce local fit.

examples.context: US phone number formatting with hyphens instead of German grouping.

top_error_patterns.description: Source content contains references (currency, country names) that are not adapted to the local context, leading to confusion or lack of relevance for the target audience.

examples.wrong: Uma moeda de 25 centavos vale 1/4 de um dólar.
examples.correct: Uma moeda de 25 centavos vale 1/4 de um real.
examples.context: Currency reference not adapted for Brazilian Portuguese; 'dólar' should be 'real'.

examples.wrong: Havia um homem de Peru,
examples.correct: Havia um homem do Peru,
examples.context: Country reference uses incorrect preposition, causing ambiguity; 'de Peru' could mean 'from turkey (bird)' instead of 'from Peru (country)'.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect use or omission of crase ('à')
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent omission or misuse of the crase ('à') in mandatory contexts, especially before feminine nouns following certain verbs or prepositions, leading to grammatical errors.

examples.wrong: movido a energia solar
examples.correct: movido à energia solar
examples.context: Preposition 'a' + feminine noun 'energia' after 'movido' requires crase.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard or incorrect past participle forms, especially with verbs that have irregular participles, resulting in unnatural or grammatically incorrect sentences.

examples.wrong: Como ele é expressado?
examples.correct: Como ele é expresso?
examples.context: Verb 'expressar' uses 'expresso' as the correct past participle in Brazilian Portuguese.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Use of Spanish loanwords instead of standard Portuguese terms
top_error_patterns.description: Inappropriate use of Spanish-origin words that are not standard in Portuguese, reducing clarity and professionalism in educational content.

examples.wrong: Encargado de criar e aprovar leis.
examples.correct: Responsável por criar e aprovar leis.
examples.context: Spanish 'Encargado' is not used in Brazilian Portuguese; 'Responsável' is correct.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect pronoun and dash usage due to English interference
top_error_patterns.description: Mixing English pronouns and punctuation (e.g., 'they' and unspaced dash) in Portuguese sentences, causing grammatical and typographic errors.

examples.wrong: consumimos—they são o combustível
examples.correct: consumimos — eles são o combustível
examples.context: English 'they' and dash format used instead of Portuguese 'eles' and spaced dash.

top_error_patterns.description: Adjectives not matching the number (singular/plural) of the nouns they modify, leading to grammatical agreement errors and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: Argumentos Convincente
examples.correct: Argumentos Convincentes
examples.context: Adjective 'Convincente' should agree in number with plural noun 'Argumentos'.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of literal translations, outdated terms, or English words instead of standard Brazilian Portuguese terminology, reducing clarity and cultural fit.

examples.wrong: Declarações Condicionais
examples.correct: Estruturas condicionais
examples.context: Programming education; 'declarações' is less common than 'estruturas'.

examples.wrong: Cornell Notes
examples.correct: Método Cornell
examples.context: Note-taking strategies; English term used instead of localized name.

examples.wrong: peixe gordo
examples.correct: peixes oleosos
examples.context: Nutrition; literal translation instead of accepted scientific term.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnatural or Literal Translations Affecting Idiomatic Style
top_error_patterns.description: Literal translations from English or awkward phrasing result in less idiomatic and less natural Brazilian Portuguese, reducing clarity and engagement.

examples.wrong: Elas reduzem o esforço necessário para realizar tarefas e estão presentes em muitos objetos do cotidiano.
examples.correct: Elas reduzem o esforço necessário para realizar tarefas e estão presentes em muitos objetos do dia a dia.
examples.context: Use of 'cotidiano' instead of 'dia a dia' for everyday objects.

examples.wrong: Em vez de desistir, ela trabalhou mais duro, aprendeu com seus contratempos e permaneceu comprometida em melhorar suas habilidades.
examples.correct: Em vez de desistir, ela se dedicou ainda mais, aprendeu com seus contratempos e manteve o compromisso de aprimorar suas habilidades.
examples.context: Literal translation of 'worked harder' instead of idiomatic 'se dedicou ainda mais'.

examples.wrong: Use pensamentos positivos, como dizer: "Eu consigo lidar com isso."
examples.correct: Use pensamentos positivos, como dizer: "Eu posso lidar com isso."
examples.context: Self-encouragement phrasing; more natural motivational tone.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Use of Emojis in Formal Educational Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as ✨, 🌍, 🎓, 🌟, 📚, and 🚀 are frequently used in introductions and explanations, which undermines the professional and neutral tone expected in Brazilian Portuguese educational materials.

examples.wrong: Bem-vindos ao fascinante mundo do Egito Antigo! ✨
examples.correct: Bem-vindos ao fascinante mundo do Egito Antigo!
examples.context: Lesson introduction; emoji removed for professionalism.

examples.wrong: Vamos explorar como essas adaptações permitem que os animais enfrentem os desafios do ambiente. 🌍
examples.correct: Vamos explorar como essas adaptações permitem que os animais enfrentem os desafios do ambiente.
examples.context: End of explanatory sentence; emoji removed for formal tone.

examples.wrong: Essas técnicas irão ajudá-lo a analisar textos com confiança e eficiência. 📚
examples.correct: Essas técnicas irão ajudá-lo a analisar textos com confiança e eficiência.
examples.context: Instructional sentence; emoji removed for academic appropriateness.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Terminology Mismatch or Inconsistent Use of Local Terms
top_error_patterns.description: Use of anglicisms, direct translations, or less common terms instead of standard Brazilian Portuguese terminology, which can hinder comprehension and localization quality.

examples.wrong: Testar a durabilidade de um smartphone simulando quedas e impactos.
examples.correct: Testar a durabilidade de um celular simulando quedas e impactos.

examples.wrong: testes padronizados
examples.correct: provas padronizadas
examples.context: Use of 'testes' instead of 'provas' for school assessments.

examples.wrong: Relatos anedóticos em redes sociais.
examples.correct: Depoimentos pessoais em redes sociais.
examples.context: Less common term replaced with more natural alternative.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Use of English Terms or Acronyms Without Localization
top_error_patterns.description: English terms, acronyms, or abbreviations are used directly in Portuguese content, which can hinder comprehension and reduce accessibility for learners.

examples.wrong: VR
examples.correct: RV
examples.context: Virtual reality abbreviation; English used instead of Portuguese.

examples.wrong: drum machines
examples.correct: caixas de ritmos
examples.context: Music technology; English term not localized.

examples.wrong: Survey, Question, Read, Recite, Review
examples.correct: Explorar, Questionar, Ler, Recitar, Revisar
examples.context: SQ3R method steps; English terms used instead of Portuguese.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnatural or Literal Translations Affecting Style
top_error_patterns.description: Literal translations or awkward phrasing that do not match Brazilian Portuguese idiomatic usage, impacting professionalism and naturalness.

examples.wrong: cumprimentar calorosamente
examples.correct: cumprimentar de forma calorosa
examples.context: Social interaction; adverbial form is unnatural.

examples.wrong: blocos fundamentais
examples.correct: elementos fundamentais
examples.context: Math education; literal translation of 'building blocks'.

examples.wrong: trabalhou mais duro
examples.correct: se dedicou ainda mais
examples.context: Describing effort; direct translation instead of idiomatic expression.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Lexical Choices that Reduce Clarity or Naturalness
top_error_patterns.description: Use of uncommon, literal, or awkward lexical items that are grammatically correct but not idiomatic or clear in Brazilian Portuguese.

examples.wrong: A localização do Egito conectava-o a outras regiões...
examples.correct: A localização do Egito conectava o país a outras regiões...
examples.context: Pronoun use is grammatically correct but unnatural.

examples.wrong: dessegregação
examples.correct: fim da segregação
examples.context: Rare or technical term replaced by a more natural phrase.

examples.wrong: Usar ferramentas como dedos ou tecidos para suavizar traços.
examples.correct: Usar ferramentas como dedos ou papel para suavizar traços.

examples.wrong: Limerique
examples.correct: Limerique
examples.context: Direct adaptation of English term; needs clarification and consistency.

top_error_patterns.description: Literal translations from English or other languages result in non-idiomatic expressions that are not standard in Brazilian Portuguese.

examples.wrong: Degradam materiais de resíduos...
examples.correct: Degradam materiais residuais...

examples.wrong: O Dia dos Mortos no México é uma tradição de honra aos entes queridos falecidos...
examples.correct: O Dia dos Mortos no México é uma tradição de homenagem aos entes queridos falecidos...
examples.context: Non-idiomatic phrase for honoring the dead.

examples.wrong: Sinto muito por sua prova...
examples.correct: Sinto muito pelo resultado da sua prova...

examples.wrong: Ela persistiu, aprendeu com os feedbacks...
examples.correct: Ela persistiu, aprendeu com os retornos...

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural Inaccuracy or Lack of Localization
top_error_patterns.description: Examples, mnemonics, or references that are not adapted to Brazilian context, reducing relatability and educational effectiveness.

examples.wrong: Exemplos incluem os Estados Unidos importando eletrônicos da China...
examples.correct: Exemplos incluem o Brasil importando eletrônicos da China...
examples.context: Trade examples; US-focused instead of Brazil-focused.

examples.wrong: Minha Velha Mãe Estudada Jamais Saberá Usar Nada
examples.correct: Minha Velha Mãe Estudou Jantar Sem Usar Nada
examples.context: Mnemonic for planets; non-standard mnemonic used.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or Unnatural Use of Educational Terms
top_error_patterns.description: Use of 'aprendizado' instead of 'aula' or 'lição' for lessons, which is not standard in Brazilian Portuguese educational contexts.

examples.wrong: Neste aprendizado, exploraremos...
examples.correct: Nesta aula, exploraremos...
examples.context: Lesson introductions; 'aprendizado' refers to the process, not the session.

examples.wrong: Este aprendizado se concentra nas células eucarióticas...
examples.correct: Esta aula se concentra nas células eucarióticas...
examples.context: Lesson focus; unnatural term for instructional unit.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission of Definite Articles in Enumeration
top_error_patterns.description: Definite articles are frequently omitted before nouns in lists or enumerations, which is required for grammatical accuracy and naturalness in Portuguese.

examples.wrong: O Islamismo influenciou profundamente a arquitetura, ciência e leis.
examples.correct: O Islamismo influenciou profundamente a arquitetura, a ciência e as leis.
examples.context: List of influenced domains missing articles.

examples.wrong: Redesenhar a estrutura de uma ponte após testes revelarem fraquezas em sua capacidade de suporte.
examples.correct: Redesenhar a estrutura de uma ponte após os testes revelarem fraquezas em sua capacidade de suporte.

examples.wrong: Um ângulo é formado quando duas linhas ou raios se encontram em um ponto chamado vértice.
examples.correct: Um ângulo é formado quando duas linhas ou dois raios se encontram em um ponto chamado vértice.
examples.context: Parallel structure and article omission in enumeration.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Ambiguous or Incorrect Use of Pronouns and Prepositions
top_error_patterns.description: Ambiguous pronoun references and missing prepositions lead to unclear or incorrect sentences, affecting comprehension.

examples.wrong: Adaptações dos animais são características ou comportamentos que aumentam sua capacidade de sobreviver...
examples.correct: Adaptações dos animais são características ou comportamentos que aumentam a capacidade dos animais de sobreviver...

examples.wrong: Trabalhem juntos para achar opções que atendam todos.
examples.correct: Trabalhem juntos para achar opções que atendam a todos.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect Use of Scientific and Quantitative Terminology
top_error_patterns.description: Errors in scientific terms and quantitative expressions, such as incorrect compound word formation or number agreement, reduce professional accuracy.

examples.wrong: A replicação é "semi-conservativa"...
examples.correct: A replicação é "semiconservativa"...
examples.context: Incorrect compound word for scientific term.

examples.wrong: O Islamismo é a segunda maior religião, com mais de 1,9 bilhões de seguidores.
examples.correct: O Islamismo é a segunda maior religião, com mais de 1,9 bilhão de seguidores.
examples.context: Incorrect pluralization for numbers between 1 and 2.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural References Lacking Context or Localization
top_error_patterns.description: References to foreign events, concepts, or names are presented without sufficient explanation or adaptation, which may confuse learners unfamiliar with the context.

examples.wrong: Marcha sobre Washington
examples.correct: Marcha sobre Washington (importante manifestação pelos direitos civis nos EUA)
examples.context: Historical event; needs parenthetical explanation for Brazilian students.

examples.wrong: testes de alfabetização
examples.correct: testes de alfabetização (literacy tests)
examples.context: US-specific concept; English term added for clarity.

examples.wrong: NGSS HS-ETS1-4
examples.correct: NGSS HS-ETS1-4
examples.context: US educational standard; would benefit from contextualization.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Missing or Incorrect Use of Definite Articles
top_error_patterns.description: Definite articles ('o', 'a', 'os', 'as') are omitted or incorrectly used, affecting the naturalness and grammatical correctness of noun phrases.

examples.wrong: Agrupamento divide informações complexas...
examples.correct: O agrupamento divide informações complexas...

examples.wrong: Que sonhava que comia seu sapato.
examples.correct: Que sonhava que comia o seu sapato.

examples.wrong: Estatísticas sobre aumento de temperatura...
examples.correct: Estatísticas sobre o aumento da temperatura...

examples.wrong: É praticado por mais de 1 bilhão de pessoas, principalmente na Índia e Nepal.
examples.correct: É praticado por mais de 1 bilhão de pessoas, principalmente na Índia e no Nepal.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnecessary Capitalization of Common Nouns and Adjectives
top_error_patterns.description: Common nouns and adjectives are incorrectly capitalized, especially in section titles, bullet points, and terms, which goes against standard Brazilian Portuguese orthographic conventions.

examples.wrong: Aquecimento Desigual
examples.correct: Aquecimento desigual

examples.wrong: Verdadeiro ou Falso.
examples.correct: Verdadeiro ou falso.

examples.wrong: Cyberbullying
examples.correct: cyberbullying

examples.wrong: O tema de *O Sol é para Todos*
examples.correct: O tema de *O Sol É Para Todos*

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-idiomatic or Less Natural Lexical Choices
top_error_patterns.description: Use of words or phrases that are grammatically correct but less idiomatic or natural in Brazilian Portuguese, affecting the flow and clarity of the text.

examples.wrong: um formato de dupla hélice
examples.correct: uma dupla hélice

examples.wrong: de forma produtiva
examples.correct: de maneira produtiva

examples.wrong: artigo de notícias
examples.correct: artigo de notícia

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Ambiguous or Incomplete Formatting in Educational Contexts
top_error_patterns.description: Ambiguous terms or incomplete references (e.g., addresses, classical music titles) reduce clarity and may not align with Brazilian educational conventions.

examples.wrong: Nome completo, endereço ou número de telefone.
examples.correct: Nome completo, endereço residencial ou número de telefone.

examples.wrong: Sinfonia nº 40
examples.correct: Sinfonia nº 40 em Sol menor
examples.context: Classical music reference; key added for completeness.

examples.wrong: Fundado pelo Profeta Muhammad no século VII.
examples.correct: Fundado pelo Profeta Maomé no século VII.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or Inconsistent Hyphenation in Compound Nouns
top_error_patterns.description: Compound nouns and scientific terms are written without required hyphens, leading to orthographic errors and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: não metais
examples.correct: não-metais

examples.wrong: semimetais
examples.correct: semi-metais

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Redundant or Non-parallel Noun and Verb Forms
top_error_patterns.description: Lack of parallelism or redundancy in noun and verb forms, such as missing plural agreement or inconsistent verb structures, which slightly affects clarity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: É a partir de uma observação que surgem perguntas e curiosidade...
examples.correct: É a partir de uma observação que surgem perguntas e curiosidades...

examples.wrong: Ratos-canguru que sobrevivem sem beber água ao extrair umidade dos alimentos e produzir urina concentrada;
examples.correct: Ratos-canguru que sobrevivem sem beber água, extraindo umidade dos alimentos e produzindo urina concentrada;

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect grammatical forms and verb usage
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent misuse of passive forms, adjectives, and action verbs leads to unclear or incorrect meaning, affecting comprehension and professional tone.

examples.wrong: 他人が聞かれ、価値を感じるようにする。
examples.correct: 他人が聞いてもらい、価値を感じるようにする。
examples.context: Incorrect passive verb form used in explanations.

examples.wrong: 平和で尊重のある方法
examples.correct: 平和的で尊重のある方法
examples.context: Improper adjective form in descriptive sentences.

examples.wrong: 減少、再利用、リサイクル、再生可能エネルギーへの切り替え
examples.correct: 減らす、再利用、リサイクル、再生可能エネルギーへの切り替え
examples.context: Incorrect noun used instead of action verb in strategy lists.

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect or non-standard terms for scientific and educational concepts reduce clarity and accuracy, especially in subject-specific contexts.

examples.wrong: 三角形は3つの直線と3つの角を持つ形状です。
examples.correct: 三角形は3つの辺と3つの角を持つ形状です。
examples.context: Non-standard term for geometric sides in math explanations.

examples.wrong: 族1の元素である水素（H）やナトリウム（Na）は非常に反応性が高い金属です。
examples.correct: 族1の元素である水素（H）やナトリウム（Na）は非常に反応性が高い元素です。
examples.context: Incorrect classification of hydrogen as a metal in science content.

examples.wrong: 音節パターンは5-7-5。
examples.correct: 音数パターンは5-7-5。
examples.context: Wrong technical term for haiku structure in literature explanations.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect use of suffixes in institutional terminology
top_error_patterns.description: Non-standard suffixes or word endings in institutional names cause confusion and reduce professionalism in headings and lists.

examples.wrong: 行政府門
examples.correct: 行政府
examples.context: Improper suffix used for government branch in section headings.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of foreign emergency numbers (e.g., '911') instead of the Japanese standard ('119'), leading to confusion and lack of cultural fit.

examples.context: Emergency contact information in quiz questions or explanations

top_error_patterns.description: Use of direct katakana transliterations for important terms (e.g., 'サイバーブリング') instead of widely accepted Japanese terminology, reducing clarity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: サイバーブリング
examples.correct: ネットいじめ
examples.context: Quiz content discussing cyberbullying or related social issues

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of grammatically correct but unnatural or awkward phrasing, including incorrect verb forms, particles, or sentence endings. These constructions reduce readability and sound non-native.

examples.wrong: 栽培することを可能にしました。
examples.correct: 栽培できるようになりました。

examples.wrong: 持つことができます。
examples.correct: 持つことがあります。

examples.wrong: 夢が現実になったことを知った。
examples.correct: 夢が現実になったと知った。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-standard use of emojis in educational content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as 🌟, 🌍, 🌏, 😊, ✨, 📚, 🚀, 🌱, 🌈, and 📖 are frequently used in lesson introductions and explanations, but are considered informal and unprofessional in Japanese educational materials, especially for formal or academic contexts.

examples.wrong: 🌟感情知能は私たちの日々の生活をより豊かにする力を秘めています！
examples.correct: 感情知能は私たちの日々の生活をより豊かにする力を秘めています！

examples.wrong: このレッスンでは、気候帯がどのように生態系や人々の活動に影響を与えるかを学びます🌍。
examples.correct: このレッスンでは、気候帯がどのように生態系や人々の活動に影響を与えるかを学びます。

examples.wrong: 今日は、バイアスの特定、証拠の評価、論理的結論の形成という重要なスキルを学びます。これらは、日常生活や学問的成功、そして市民としての責任ある議論に不可欠なものです。✨
examples.correct: 今日は、バイアスの特定、証拠の評価、論理的結論の形成という重要なスキルを学びます。これらは、日常生活や学問的成功、そして市民としての責任ある議論に不可欠なものです。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect punctuation: Western colon (:) instead of Japanese full-width colon (：)
top_error_patterns.description: The Western colon (:) is used in headings, examples, and lists, but Japanese educational content requires the full-width colon (：) for proper punctuation and naturalness.

examples.wrong: 熱帯気候: 高温多湿で赤道付近に位置。
examples.correct: 熱帯気候：高温多湿で赤道付近に位置します。

examples.wrong: 例: アマゾン熱帯雨林は熱帯気候帯に属しています。
examples.correct: 例：アマゾン熱帯雨林は熱帯気候帯に属しています。

examples.wrong: 農業: 気候帯に応じた作物が栽培される（例: 温帯地域では小麦、熱帯地域では稲）。
examples.correct: 農業：気候帯に応じた作物が栽培される（例：温帯地域では小麦、熱帯地域では稲）。

top_error_patterns.description: Direct translations, loanwords, or verbose expressions are used instead of standard Japanese terms, reducing clarity and professionalism. Examples include '仮想アシスタント' vs. 'バーチャルアシスタント', '敵役' vs. '悪役', and missing parenthetical explanations for foreign concepts.

examples.wrong: 敵役
examples.correct: 悪役

examples.wrong: 仮想アシスタント
examples.correct: バーチャルアシスタント

examples.wrong: エトス、パトス、ロゴス
examples.correct: エトス（信頼性）、パトス（感情）、ロゴス（論理）

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of direct English loanwords (katakana) instead of standard Japanese terms, leading to unnatural or unclear expressions in educational contexts.

examples.wrong: オルガネラ
examples.correct: 細胞小器官

examples.wrong: ダブルベース
examples.correct: コントラバス

examples.wrong: スーツ
examples.correct: マーク

top_error_patterns.description: Sentence fragments, plain forms, or abrupt expressions are used instead of complete, polite, and natural sentences expected in Japanese educational materials. This affects clarity and tone.

examples.wrong: 「公民権運動の母」として知られる。
examples.correct: 「公民権運動の母」として知られています。

examples.wrong: コーネル式やアウトライン形式を活用。
examples.correct: コーネル式やアウトライン形式を活用する。

examples.wrong: 日記を書く。
examples.correct: 日記を書いたりする。

top_error_patterns.description: Literal translations, awkward phrasing, or use of expressions that do not match Japanese educational or literary style, affecting readability and tone.

examples.wrong: 動物の環境適応への旅へ！
examples.correct: 動物の環境適応について学びましょう！

examples.wrong: 小さな進歩でも祝う。
examples.correct: 小さな進歩でも喜ぶ。

examples.wrong: 活気のある民主主義
examples.correct: 活発な民主主義

top_error_patterns.description: Use of words or phrases that are technically correct but not standard in educational, scientific, or cultural contexts. This includes misuse of terms and failure to use established Japanese equivalents.

examples.wrong: 読む力を高める
examples.correct: 読解力を高める

examples.wrong: ドライバー（車輪と軸またはねじ）
examples.correct: ドライバー（ねじ）
examples.context: Science education: classification of simple machines

examples.wrong: 贈り物
examples.correct: おくりもの

top_error_patterns.description: Particles such as 'は', 'には', and 'での' are frequently omitted or incorrectly used, leading to unnatural or ambiguous sentences. Proper particle usage is essential for clarity and grammatical accuracy in Japanese.

examples.wrong: 不正義に直面した際の即時行動と自衛の必要性を強調しました。
examples.correct: 不正義に直面した際には即時行動と自衛の必要性を強調しました。
examples.context: Missing 'には' after '際' clarifies the conditional context.

examples.wrong: 自分のオンライン行動と他者への影響を批判的に考えることが大切です。
examples.correct: 自分のオンラインでの行動と他者への影響を批判的に考えることが大切です。
examples.context: Missing 'での' after 'オンライン' for correct modification.

examples.wrong: 公式のように見えるメールでパスワードを要求された場合、送信者の正体を確認しましょう。
examples.correct: 公式のように見えるメールでパスワードを要求された場合は、送信者の正体を確認しましょう。
examples.context: Missing 'は' after '場合' for conditional clause.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Cultural Inappropriateness or Lack of Localization
top_error_patterns.description: Examples, terms, or explanations that do not fit Japanese cultural context, causing confusion or reducing relatability for learners.

examples.wrong: 七面鳥サンドイッチ
examples.correct: チキンサンドイッチ
examples.context: Food examples unfamiliar to Japanese learners

examples.wrong: ネイティブアメリカン
examples.correct: 先住民
examples.context: Referring to indigenous peoples in history lessons

examples.wrong: 20円で、3枚購入すると合計費用は:
examples.correct: 2,000円で、3枚購入すると合計費用は:

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Orthographic errors and unnatural set phrases
top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect use of set phrases, punctuation, or loanwords, leading to unnatural or nonstandard written Japanese. This includes misuse of particles in set phrases and inappropriate punctuation.

examples.wrong: 世界の七不思議
examples.correct: 世界七不思議
examples.context: Set phrase for 'Seven Wonders of the World'

examples.wrong: 滅菌バンデージ
examples.correct: 滅菌包帯

top_error_patterns.description: Errors in listing actions or predicates, such as incorrect use of the te-form, missing commas, or improper verb forms, affect sentence flow and clarity.

examples.wrong: 感情は、私たちが周囲の出来事にどのように感じて反応するかを教えてくれる大切な部分です。
examples.correct: 感情は、私たちが周囲の出来事にどのように感じ、反応するかを教えてくれる大切な部分です。

examples.wrong: 教育的目的: 教える、説明する、証拠を提供するために使用される。
examples.correct: 教育的目的: 教えたり、説明したり、証拠を提供したりするために使用される。
examples.context: Missing '-たり' form for listing multiple actions.

examples.wrong: 読むほど、さまざまな種類のテキストを理解し分析する能力が向上します。
examples.correct: 読むほど、さまざまな種類のテキストを理解し、分析する能力が向上します。

top_error_patterns.description: Non-standard orthographic forms, such as missing middle dots in loanwords, incorrect use of half-width punctuation, and inappropriate symbols (e.g., emojis), reduce professionalism and readability.

examples.wrong: アクティブリスニング
examples.correct: アクティブ・リスニング
examples.context: Missing middle dot in compound loanword.

examples.wrong: 魔法学校に通う若い魔法使いの物語（例:『ハリー・ポッター』）。
examples.correct: 魔法学校に通う若い魔法使いの物語（例：『ハリー・ポッター』）。
examples.context: Half-width colon used instead of full-width.
Emoji used in formal educational content.
Half-width slash used in units instead of full-width.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of ambiguous, incorrect, or nonstandard terms in scientific, technical, or academic contexts, reducing clarity and accuracy.

examples.wrong: 星や雷
examples.correct: 恒星や雷

examples.wrong: 州間通商
examples.correct: 州際通商

examples.wrong: 裁判官は大統領によって任命され
examples.correct: 連邦裁判官は大統領によって任命され

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms or descriptions that do not align with Japanese cultural, religious, or scientific standards, affecting localization fit and learner comprehension.

examples.wrong: 死を称えるヴェーサックの祝祭
examples.correct: 入滅を称えるヴェーサックの祝祭

examples.wrong: 金曜の夕方から土曜の夕方まで
examples.correct: 金曜の日没から土曜の日没まで

top_error_patterns.description: Several sentences are fragments lacking a verb or copula ('です'), resulting in incomplete statements. This affects readability and consistency, especially in educational contexts.

examples.wrong: 話す猫が謎を解く短編小説。
examples.correct: 話す猫が謎を解く短編小説です。
examples.context: Missing 'です' at the end to complete the sentence.

examples.wrong: 植物の成長について説明する科学教科書。
examples.correct: 植物の成長について説明する科学教科書です。
examples.context: Fragment without copula; needs 'です' for completion.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of abbreviations or foreign educational concepts without explanation, leading to potential confusion for Japanese learners.

examples.wrong: NGSSとの連携
examples.correct: NGSS（次世代科学基準）との連携

examples.wrong: 感情知能（EI）
examples.correct: 感情知能（EQ）

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnatural or overly formal verb and word choices
top_error_patterns.description: Verbs and expressions such as '比較します', '必要です', '使用します', and '学びが深まります' are used where more natural, idiomatic, or softer alternatives are preferred in Japanese educational style.

examples.wrong: 分母が同じ場合は、分子を比較します。
examples.correct: 分母が同じ場合は、分子を比べます。

examples.wrong: クラスメートとのグループプロジェクトでは、積極的に意見を共有し、意見の違いを尊重しながら解決することが必要です。
examples.correct: クラスメートとのグループプロジェクトでは、積極的に意見を共有し、意見の違いを尊重しながら解決することが大切です。

examples.wrong: 学びが深まります
examples.correct: 理解が深まります

top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard or less natural terminology, such as incorrect device names or verb choices, can reduce clarity and professional tone.

examples.wrong: 探知機全体は10年ごとに交換する。
examples.correct: 探知機本体は10年ごとに交換する。

examples.wrong: 感情的な洞察を行動や意思決定に活用する。
examples.correct: 感情的な洞察を行動や意思決定に活かす。
examples.context: Less natural verb choice for 'apply insights'.

top_error_patterns.description: Recurring misuse or imprecise definition of key technical terms (e.g., 'variable', 'hypothesis', 'limerick structure'), leading to conceptual confusion and misinformation.

examples.wrong: Variables in algebra can be letters or symbols, and sometimes numbers.
examples.correct: Variables in algebra are typically represented by letters or symbols, but not by numbers.
examples.context: Algebraic terminology misused, confusing variables with constants.

examples.wrong: Variables in algebra can be represented by letters, numbers, or symbols, depending on the context and the preference of the mathematician.
examples.correct: Variables in algebra are represented by letters or symbols, not by numbers.
examples.context: Incorrectly suggests numbers can be variables.

examples.wrong: Random guesses, known as 'hypotheses,' are actually well-considered, testable predictions that are opposite to what is expected.
examples.correct: Random guesses are not considered 'hypotheses.' Hypotheses are well-considered, testable predictions based on prior knowledge and observation.
examples.context: Conflates random guesses with hypotheses, misrepresenting scientific terminology.

examples.wrong: A Limerick always ends with a couplet that rhymes.
examples.correct: A Limerick always contains a couplet that rhymes as its third and fourth lines.
examples.context: Incorrectly describes the structure of a limerick.

examples.wrong: In Python, a variable named 'temperature' is expected to hold a number representing a measurement like degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit, not a string.
examples.correct: In Python, a variable named 'temperature' can be assigned any data type, including a string.
examples.context: Incorrectly implies variable names enforce data types in Python.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of awkward or confusing sentence structures that obscure intended meaning and reduce clarity for learners.

examples.wrong: In DNA, the sequence of nitrogenous bases can be read in a direction only.
examples.correct: In DNA, the sequence of nitrogenous bases can be read in only one direction.
examples.context: Unclear phrasing makes the scientific concept difficult to understand.

examples.wrong: Random guesses, known as 'hypotheses,' are actually well-considered, testable predictions that are opposite to what is expected.
examples.correct: Random guesses are not known as 'hypotheses.' Hypotheses are well-considered, testable predictions.
examples.context: Confusing sentence structure leads to conceptual misunderstanding.

top_error_patterns.description: Quiz items and feedback are presented in the source language (Polish) instead of the target language (English), causing confusion and reducing accessibility for English-speaking learners.

examples.wrong: Złamanie DNA może prowadzić do nowych cech biologicznych.
examples.correct: DNA breakage can lead to new biological traits.
examples.context: Quiz statement appears in Polish rather than English.

examples.wrong: Warstwa znaczenia DNA polega na przekazywaniu genetycznych informacji przez pokolenia, co jest kluczowe dla przejawiania życia poprzez podziały komórek. Zmiany w jego strukturze, często nazywane mutacjami, mogą prowadzić do nowych cech, które mogą wpłynąć na rozwój organizmu. To zrozumienie jest kluczowe dla różnych dziedzin nauki, w tym biologii, medycyny i nauki kryminalnej.
examples.correct: The significance of DNA lies in transmitting genetic information across generations, which is crucial for the manifestation of life through cell division. Changes in its structure, often called mutations, can lead to new traits that may affect organism development. This understanding is key in various scientific fields, including biology, medicine, and forensic science.
examples.context: Feedback provided in Polish instead of English, disrupting educational flow.

top_error_patterns.description: Recurring use of vague or imprecise wording that reduces clarity and may confuse learners about key concepts.

examples.wrong: By embedding information within a story, it becomes more memorable due to the learning material and emotional engagement.
examples.correct: By embedding information within a story, it becomes more memorable due to the context and emotional engagement.
examples.context: Unclear explanation of why stories aid memory; 'learning material' is not a logical cause.

examples.wrong: A Limerick consists of five lines, where the first, second, and fifth lines rhyme with each other, and the third and fourth lines form a shorter rhyming couplet. This characteristic structure is a defining feature of Limericks.
examples.correct: A Limerick consists of five lines, where the first, second, and fifth lines rhyme with each other, and the third and fourth lines form a shorter rhyming couplet in the middle. This characteristic structure is a defining feature of Limericks.
examples.context: Lack of specificity about the position of the couplet may confuse learners about the limerick's structure.

examples.wrong: This ensures that the scientific method is a systematic and objective process based on evidence and logical reasoning.
examples.correct: This ensures that the scientific method is a systematic and objective process based on evidence and logical reasoning, rather than random guessing.
examples.context: Missing explicit contrast with random guessing, which is central to the concept being taught.

top_error_patterns.description: Misleading or incorrect statements about core subject matter, potentially causing misunderstanding of fundamental concepts.

examples.wrong: While Python is a dynamically typed language, and variables are not fixed to a single data type, changing a variable's data type at runtime can cause errors. Python variables are flexible, but they must be used appropriately according to their assigned data type.
examples.correct: While Python is a dynamically typed language and variables are not fixed to a single data type, changing a variable's data type at runtime does not inherently cause errors. Errors only occur if the variable is used in a way that is incompatible with its current data type.
examples.context: Incorrectly suggests that changing a variable's type in Python is inherently error-prone, which misrepresents dynamic typing.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of unnecessarily verbose or awkward expressions to indicate time periods, such as 'after the end of World War II' instead of the more concise 'after World War II.' This affects clarity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: after the end of World War II
examples.correct: after World War II
examples.context: Describing historical events and their timing

examples.wrong: in the aftermath of World War II, not after its end
examples.correct: after the end of World War II
examples.context: Clarifying the timeline of events following World War II

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect word choices, false cognates, or direct translations from English that distort meaning or technical accuracy.

examples.wrong: Son de Reverde
examples.correct: Sueño de Rev. King
examples.context: Incorrect reference to Martin Luther King Jr.'s speech.

examples.wrong: números sin signo
examples.correct: números con o sin signo
examples.context: Technical term misused, leading to conceptual error.

examples.wrong: El rock music
examples.correct: El rock
examples.context: Unnecessary English word in Spanish context.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent mismatches between articles/adjectives and the gender or number of nouns, leading to grammatical inaccuracies and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: la camuflaje
examples.correct: el camuflaje
examples.context: Incorrect gender article for masculine noun.

examples.wrong: las sentimientos
examples.correct: los sentimientos
examples.context: Incorrect gender and number agreement with plural masculine noun.

examples.wrong: las recuerdos
examples.correct: los recuerdos
examples.context: Incorrect gender article for masculine plural noun.

top_error_patterns.description: Misspelled words and missing accent marks reduce professionalism and can hinder comprehension.

examples.wrong: individués
examples.correct: individuos

examples.wrong: diagnócias médicas
examples.correct: diagnósticos médicos

examples.wrong: mnemonicos
examples.correct: mnemónicos
examples.context: Missing accent mark on technical term.

top_error_patterns.description: Verbs do not match the subject in person or number, causing confusion and undermining grammatical correctness.

examples.wrong: la función de generar energía la realiza principalmente las mitocondrias
examples.correct: la función de generar energía la realizan principalmente las mitocondrias
examples.context: Verb should agree with plural subject.

examples.wrong: mejoras se realizan
examples.correct: se realizan mejoras
examples.context: Passive construction error; missing reflexive pronoun.

examples.wrong: nunca confía en compartir información personal
examples.correct: nunca confíes en compartir información personal
examples.context: Incorrect verb form for imperative advice.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard, anglicized, or inaccurate terms for technical or cultural concepts, affecting localization and educational value.

examples.wrong: cheques y balances
examples.correct: pesos y contrapesos
examples.context: Direct anglicism for government system terminology.

examples.wrong: puentes levantadores
examples.correct: polipastos

examples.wrong: velocidad de escape para mantener una órbita
examples.correct: velocidad constante hacia adelante para mantener una órbita

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect Use of Anglicisms for Established Terms
top_error_patterns.description: Anglicized terms are used instead of standard Spanish terminology for well-known concepts, leading to confusion and reduced professionalism.

examples.wrong: el Sphinx
examples.correct: la Esfinge
examples.context: Referring to the famous Egyptian monument in quiz questions.

examples.wrong: máquinas de palanca inclinada
examples.correct: máquinas de plano inclinado
examples.context: Describing simple machines in educational content.

top_error_patterns.description: Explanations misrepresent common practices in Spanish-speaking cultures, such as the use of algebra for adjusting recipe quantities, leading to misleading or inaccurate feedback.

examples.wrong: El álgebra no se usa para ajustar fracciones de ingredientes.
examples.correct: El álgebra puede utilizarse para ajustar cantidades de ingredientes, incluyendo fracciones.
examples.context: Feedback on math applications in cooking contexts.

top_error_patterns.description: Omission or misuse of definite articles ('el', 'la', 'los', 'las') in general statements, enumerations, or before abstract concepts, leading to unnatural or grammatically incorrect sentences.

examples.wrong: No ficción está destinada a informar y educar sobre hechos verídicos...
examples.correct: La no ficción está destinada a informar y educar sobre hechos verídicos...

examples.wrong: fragmentación de información
examples.correct: fragmentación de la información

examples.wrong: Acrónimos ayudan a simplificar y recordar información ordenada...
examples.correct: Los acrónimos ayudan a simplificar y recordar información ordenada...

examples.wrong: Utilizar solo ethos es suficiente para persuadir a la audiencia.
examples.correct: Utilizar solo el ethos es suficiente para persuadir a la audiencia.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of words or phrases that are not the most accurate or standard for the context, especially in technical, scientific, or educational explanations, which can mislead or confuse learners.

examples.wrong: El ADN almacena solo la información genética necesaria para la vida de la célula.
examples.correct: El ADN almacena no solo la información genética necesaria para la vida de la célula, sino también información relevante para la heredabilidad y la síntesis de proteínas.
examples.context: Biological function limited by imprecise wording

examples.wrong: Los ángulos mayores de 180° se denominan ángulos mayores o reflejos...
examples.correct: Los ángulos mayores de 180° se denominan ángulos reflejos...

examples.wrong: Esta declaración no refleja con precisión la relación entre programación y diseño.
examples.correct: Esta declaración no refleja con precisión la relación entre programación y algoritmos.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that are literal translations or less standard in Spanish educational, scientific, or professional contexts. Corrections favor more widely accepted or idiomatic terminology.

examples.wrong: atención plena
examples.correct: mindfulness

examples.wrong: usar un paño limpio para evitar infección.
examples.correct: usar un paño limpio para evitar infecciones.

examples.wrong: lo que refleja cómo la luz interactúa...
examples.correct: lo que muestra cómo la luz interactúa...

examples.wrong: La lectura rápida es ideal para obtener una idea general...
examples.correct: La lectura rápida es ideal para obtener una visión general...

examples.wrong: manejo del tiempo
examples.correct: gestión del tiempo

examples.wrong: proceso de prueba de vacunas
examples.correct: proceso de ensayo de vacunas

examples.wrong: simplificar fracciones para encontrar equivalentes.
examples.correct: reducir fracciones para encontrar equivalentes.

top_error_patterns.description: Errors in coordinating nouns, adjectives, or clauses, such as missing articles in lists, incorrect use of conjunctions, or lack of parallel structure, which reduce clarity and grammatical accuracy.

examples.wrong: Se trata de la autoconciencia, empatía y habilidades interpersonales, no del conocimiento académico o la memoria.
examples.correct: Se trata de la autoconciencia, la empatía y las habilidades interpersonales, no del conocimiento académico ni de la memoria.
examples.context: Enumeration missing articles and incorrect conjunction

examples.wrong: La afirmación es incorrecta porque la deforestación tiene un impacto negativo significativo en los ecosistemas locales... y alteración de los patrones de precipitación...
examples.correct: ...y la alteración de los patrones de precipitación...

top_error_patterns.description: Use of gerunds, participles, or sentence structures that do not connect properly to the subject or main clause, resulting in dangling modifiers or awkward phrasing that impairs clarity.

examples.wrong: Proporcionando recursos esenciales como agua y nutrientes, permitió la agricultura...
examples.correct: Al proporcionar recursos esenciales como agua y nutrientes, permitió la agricultura...

examples.wrong: siguiendo pasos lógicos y basados en evidencia puede ser muy útil.
examples.correct: seguir pasos lógicos y basados en evidencia puede ser muy útil.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of passive voice or less idiomatic phrasing that is grammatically correct but unnatural in Spanish educational contexts. Active voice or more idiomatic expressions are preferred for clarity and engagement.

examples.wrong: Su importancia en la programación no puede ser subestimada.
examples.correct: Su importancia en la programación no debe subestimarse.

examples.wrong: Estas características son transmitidas de generación en generación...
examples.correct: Estas características se transmiten de generación en generación...

examples.wrong: Siempre evalúa si la información que deseas compartir podría ser utilizada...
examples.correct: Siempre evalúa si la información que deseas compartir podría ser usada...
