examples.correct: A programação é uma ferramenta essencial em uma ampla gama de setores, como tecnologia, saúde, finanças e outros.
examples.context: Use of 'indústrias' and 'campos' instead of more natural terms.

examples.wrong: O efeito da inclinação em um plano inclinado é deslocar a força necessária ao longo de uma distância maior, reduzindo assim o esforço necessário para mover um objeto.
examples.correct: O efeito da inclinação em um plano inclinado é distribuir o esforço ao longo de uma distância maior, reduzindo a força necessária para mover um objeto.
examples.context: Unnatural phrasing and misleading scientific explanation.

examples.wrong: Uma roda com eixo é projetada para facilitar o movimento de objetos, reduzindo a força necessária. Isso se deve à sua capacidade de rolar, o que oferece uma vantagem mecânica ao contrário de um plano inclinado, que exige mais esforço para movimentar objetos devido à sua superfície plana.
examples.correct: Uma roda com eixo é projetada para facilitar o movimento de objetos, reduzindo a força necessária. Isso ocorre porque a roda permite que os objetos rolem, oferecendo uma vantagem mecânica em relação ao plano inclinado, que exige mais esforço devido ao atrito.
examples.context: Awkward comparison and lack of clarity in mechanical explanation.

examples.wrong: Apreciar as diferenças e semelhanças entre várias tradições espirituais melhora a coexistência pacífica entre as pessoas.
examples.correct: Respeitar e compreender as diferenças entre várias tradições espirituais contribui para a coexistência pacífica entre as pessoas.
examples.context: Less natural and less culturally appropriate phrasing for educational content.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of European Portuguese spelling or capitalization errors that do not conform to Brazilian Portuguese standards, affecting localization fit and professionalism.

examples.wrong: selectiva
examples.correct: seletiva

examples.wrong: sol
examples.correct: Sol
examples.context: Referring to the star in astronomy/science

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms or lexical choices that do not match standard Brazilian Portuguese usage or the subject matter, affecting professional tone and correctness.

examples.wrong: em desenho
examples.correct: no desenho

examples.wrong: liberdade de pensamento
examples.correct: liberdade de expressão
examples.context: Terminology mismatch with the referenced legal document.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of the masculine article 'o' with 'internet' instead of the correct feminine 'a', which is a common localization error in Brazilian Portuguese.

examples.wrong: utilizam o internet
examples.correct: utilizam a internet
examples.context: Incorrect article usage for a common noun.

top_error_patterns.description: Misspellings, missing accents, or incorrect hyphenation that affect word correctness and pronunciation. These errors are minor but can impact professional tone.

examples.wrong: prototipos
examples.correct: protótipos

examples.wrong: característica chave
examples.correct: característica-chave

examples.wrong: no marketing e publicidade
examples.correct: em marketing e publicidade

top_error_patterns.description: Unnecessarily wordy or awkward sentence constructions. Corrections involve streamlining syntax for clarity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: partículas que estão organizadas em um padrão específico
examples.correct: partículas organizadas em um padrão específico

examples.wrong: Não se responsabiliza por criar leis, que é a função do Poder Legislativo, nem fiscaliza o Executivo, que é uma função do Poder Executivo.
examples.correct: Não é responsável por criar leis, que é função do Poder Legislativo, nem por fiscalizar o Executivo, que é função do Poder Executivo.
examples.context: Awkward passive construction and unnecessary articles.

top_error_patterns.description: Omission or incorrect use of articles and prepositions, affecting clarity and grammatical correctness.

examples.wrong: absorver água suficiente da sua dieta
examples.correct: absorver água suficiente de sua dieta

examples.wrong: como queratina, que é a principal proteína presente no cabelo
examples.correct: como a queratina, que é a principal proteína presente no cabelo
examples.context: Missing definite article before specific compound.

top_error_patterns.description: Feedback or analogies lack cultural relevance or omit key local/cultural details, reducing educational value or relatability. Corrections add culturally appropriate examples or analogies.

examples.wrong: O Ano Novo Chinês... o evento principal não inclui carros alegóricos.
examples.correct: ...o evento principal não inclui carros alegóricos, mas sim apresentações como a Dança do Leão e do Dragão.
examples.context: Missing iconic cultural elements; correction adds relevant details.

examples.wrong: É como quando você testa um novo prato...
examples.correct: É como testar uma solução e perceber que alguns aspectos funcionam bem...
examples.context: Analogy not universally relatable; correction uses neutral analogy.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of unnecessarily repetitive or verbose sentences that can be streamlined for clarity and conciseness. Corrections favor more direct and readable phrasing.

examples.wrong: Alimentos ricos em açúcar... Ao escolher lanches, é melhor optar por opções que incluam frutas...
examples.correct: Alimentos ricos em açúcar... prefira opções com frutas...
examples.context: Repetitive and formal; correction is concise.

examples.wrong: A alavanca é, de fato, uma máquina simples que pode ajudar a levantar pesos pesados...
examples.correct: A alavanca é uma máquina simples que pode ajudar a levantar pesos maiores...
examples.context: Wordy and redundant; correction streamlines explanation.

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect or non-standard word choices, including scientific terms and everyday vocabulary, leading to factual inaccuracies and confusion. Often involves misuse of technical terms or invented words.

examples.wrong: ミトコンドリアは細胞内のリン脂肪である。
examples.correct: ミトコンドリアは細胞内のリン脂質である。

examples.wrong: 原子構成は元素の酸素電子数によって決定されます。
examples.correct: 原子構成は元素の原子番号によって決定されます。
examples.context: Non-existent term '酸素電子数' used instead of '原子番号'.

examples.wrong: 物語の中心的なアイデアは物語の説得力としかりみです。
examples.correct: 物語の中心的なアイデアは物語の説得力と魅力です。
examples.context: Invented word 'しかりみ' instead of standard '魅力'.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent misuse of negative and affirmative verb forms, resulting in statements that contradict intended meaning or scientific facts. This confuses learners and undermines educational accuracy.

examples.wrong: 感情はみんなが経験するものではありません。
examples.correct: 感情はみんなが経験するものです。
examples.context: Negative form used where affirmative is required to express universality.

examples.wrong: 元素の原子番号は同じ族の中で変わります。
examples.correct: 元素の原子番号は同じ族の中で変わりません。
examples.context: Affirmative verb used instead of negative, contradicting scientific fact.

examples.wrong: オンラインで共有される情報は必ずしも重要です。
examples.correct: オンラインで共有される情報は必ずしも重要ではありません。
examples.context: Affirmative verb form misused with '必ずしも', which requires negation.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of incorrect kanji, corrupted characters, Chinese characters, or misspellings that are not standard in Japanese. These errors disrupt readability and can confuse learners.

examples.wrong: 儿 童は自分の感情を完全に理解することができます。
examples.correct: 子どもは自分の感情を完全に理解することができます。
examples.context: Chinese '儿童' used instead of Japanese '子ども'.

examples.wrong: 紙箊
examples.correct: 包帯

examples.wrong: 強力なパスワードは短く簡����antoいすることが推奨されます。
examples.correct: 強力なパスワードは短く簡単にすることが推奨されます。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Double Punctuation and Non-Standard Sentence Endings
top_error_patterns.description: Sentences end with both Japanese full stop (。) and Western period (.) or other redundant punctuation, which is not standard in Japanese writing. This affects professionalism and readability.

examples.wrong: 感情は私たちの行動や考え方に影響を与え、人間関係において重要な役割を果たします。.
examples.correct: 感情は私たちの行動や考え方に影響を与え、人間関係において重要な役割を果たします。
examples.context: Redundant period after Japanese full stop.

examples.wrong: 感謝祭は主にアメリらみとカナダで祝われる独特の祝日です。日本には異なる祝日がありますが、感謝祭はそのような祝日の一つではありません。.
examples.correct: 感謝祭は主にアメリカとカナダで祝われる独特の祝日です。日本には異なる祝日がありますが、感謝祭はそのような祝日の一つではありません。

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences constructed in a way that is unclear, ambiguous, or ungrammatical, making it difficult for learners to understand the intended meaning. Often involves incorrect clause order or missing logical connectors.

examples.wrong: 感情は私たちの経験、たとえそれが短期間であっても長期間もあります。
examples.correct: 感情は私たちの経験、たとえそれが短期間であっても、長期間にも影響を与えます。
examples.context: Unclear clause structure; missing logical connection.

examples.wrong: これにより、助けることができる状況に己がることが保証されます。
examples.correct: これにより、助けることができる状況に身を置くことが保証されます。
examples.context: Non-standard verb '己がる' used instead of '身を置く'.

top_error_patterns.description: Japanese sentences end with both a full-width period (。) and a half-width period (.), resulting in double punctuation. Only the Japanese full stop should be used.

examples.wrong: ナイル川はエジプトの生涯にわたる経済発展の重要な要因でした。.
examples.correct: ナイル川はエジプトの生涯にわたる経済発展の重要な要因でした。
examples.context: Sentence endings throughout quiz feedback and explanations.

examples.wrong: 果物はビタミンとミネラルが豊富です。.
examples.correct: 果物はビタミンとミネラルが豊富です。

examples.wrong: 科学的手法は主に芸術的なスキルの発展を目指すために使われます。.
examples.correct: 科学的手法は主に芸術的なスキルの発展を目指すために使われます。

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences end with both a Japanese full stop (。) and an English period (.), resulting in unnatural and incorrect punctuation.

examples.wrong: 資源が豊富な地域は経済が繁荣することが一般的です。.
examples.correct: 資源が豊富な地域は経済が繁栄することが一般的です。
examples.context: Sentence endings in feedback and explanations.

examples.wrong: 火の三角形は火災を引き起こすのには不可欠ではありません。.
examples.correct: 火の三角形は火災を引き起こすのに不可欠ではありません。

examples.wrong: トランプには4つのスーツがあり、それぞれには13枚のカードがあります。.
examples.correct: トランプには4つのスーツがあり、それぞれに13枚のカードがあります。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Unnatural Sentence Structure and Particle Usage
top_error_patterns.description: Awkward phrasing, incorrect particles, or unnatural sentence structure that impairs clarity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: この私たちの食事には、炭水化物をサラダやご飯に...
examples.correct: 私たちの食事には、サラダやご飯から炭水化物...

examples.wrong: 例えば、ある人は特定の状況で混乱を感じることがある人もいれば、その人が落ち込んだり、喜びを感じることがある人もいます。
examples.correct: 例えば、ある人は特定の状況で混乱を感じることがある一方で、落ち込んだり、喜びを感じることがある人もいます。

examples.wrong: サイコロの振るという行為では...
examples.correct: サイコロを振るという行為では...

top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard, confusing, or inappropriate words that reduce clarity and professional tone.

examples.wrong: グローバル貿易は経済成長を消減させることがあります。.
examples.correct: グローバル貿易は経済成長を減少させることがあります。

examples.wrong: 情報を小さな部分に分けることで...記憶の力を最大限に活用する秘謀です。.
examples.correct: ...記憶の力を最大限に活用する秘訣です。

examples.wrong: 例えば、陸上動物が冬になると皮が退色することはありません。
examples.correct: 例えば、陸上動物が冬になると毛が退色することはありません。

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect Use of Chinese Characters or Loanwords
top_error_patterns.description: Use of Chinese characters or unnatural loanwords not standard in Japanese, leading to confusion or lack of localization fit.

examples.wrong: 資源が豊富な地域は経済が繁荣することが一般的です。.
examples.correct: 資源が豊富な地域は経済が繁栄することが一般的です。
examples.context: Economic terminology using Chinese character '荣' instead of Japanese '栄'.

examples.wrong: パイプラインインターミディエンス
examples.correct: パイプライン処理

top_error_patterns.description: Use of unnatural or awkward Japanese expressions that do not align with standard usage, leading to confusion or reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: 感謝と支払いの形で承認を得る
examples.correct: 許可を得る
examples.context: Describing how to obtain permission from an author; original phrasing is misleading and unnatural.

examples.wrong: フィールドが異なる可能性がある
examples.correct: 状況や価値観が異なる可能性がある
examples.context: Explaining differences in online interactions; original uses a direct translation that is not idiomatic in Japanese.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of words or phrases that are not commonly used in Japanese, resulting in unclear or awkward statements.

examples.wrong: 水を喉に入れる
examples.correct: 水を喉に流し込む
examples.context: Describing the act of drinking water; original phrase is not idiomatic and may confuse learners.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Half-width Period Used Instead of Japanese Full Stop
top_error_patterns.description: Sentences end with a half-width period (.) instead of the Japanese full-width period (。), which is incorrect in Japanese writing.

examples.wrong: エトスは、単に強力な言葉だけで成り立っている。
examples.correct: エトスは、単に強力な言葉だけで成り立っている。
examples.context: Quiz statements and feedback in persuasive writing section.

examples.wrong: パトスは、聴衆の共通の価値観に訴えることで行動を促す技法です。
examples.correct: パトスは、聴衆の共通の価値観に訴えることで行動を促す技法です。

top_error_patterns.description: Phrases are used that are grammatically correct but unnatural or verbose in Japanese, affecting the flow and professionalism of the text.

examples.wrong: 生物がする行動的適応
examples.correct: 生物が行う行動的適応

examples.wrong: あることはありますが
examples.correct: あることもありますが

examples.wrong: 適応とは限らないということになります
examples.correct: 適応とは限りません

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Missing or Incorrect Use of Japanese Comma (読点)
top_error_patterns.description: Japanese comma (、) is missing after adverbs or introductory phrases, making sentences less natural and harder to read.

examples.wrong: 金属は通常陽イオンになります。
examples.correct: 金属は通常、陽イオンになります。

top_error_patterns.description: Use of word combinations that are grammatically correct but not idiomatic in Japanese, reducing clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: 起こる特性
examples.correct: 現れる特性

top_error_patterns.description: Use of expressions that are too formal or philosophical for basic educational contexts, reducing naturalness and accessibility.

examples.wrong: 本質的にはそうです。
examples.correct: 基本的にはそうです。
examples.context: Feedback in educational quizzes; '本質的' is too abstract for the context.

examples.wrong: 学習する際に
examples.correct: 学習の場面で
examples.context: Describing learning situations; '学習する際に' is less natural than '学習の場面で'.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms or phrases that are less standard or precise in educational Japanese, affecting clarity and appropriateness.

examples.wrong: 市場の動態
examples.correct: 市場の動向
examples.context: Economics context; '市場の動向' is the standard term.

examples.wrong: 基本的な使用
examples.correct: 基本的な使い方
examples.context: Describing how to use variables and constants; '使い方' is more natural.

top_error_patterns.description: Repetition of the same word or concept within a sentence, leading to unnatural and unclear phrasing.

examples.wrong: 他人の幸福や幸福を考えることで
examples.correct: 他人の幸福を考えることで
examples.context: General explanation; repetition of '幸福' is unnecessary.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent misuse of grammatical cases, especially locative, genitive, and instrumental, leading to confusion and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: у своје средине
examples.correct: у својим срединама

examples.wrong: са снег
examples.correct: са снегом

examples.wrong: преко процес природна селекција
examples.correct: путем процеса природне селекције

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent mismatches in gender, number, and case between subjects, verbs, and adjectives, causing ambiguity and unprofessional tone.

examples.wrong: Животиње су развијали
examples.correct: Животиње су се развијале
examples.context: Verb form does not agree with subject

examples.wrong: невероватни начини
examples.correct: невероватне начине
examples.context: Adjective does not agree with noun in gender and case

examples.wrong: Арктички лисица
examples.correct: Арктичка лисица
examples.context: Adjective does not agree with noun in gender

top_error_patterns.description: Omission or misplacement of the reflexive particle 'се', which is essential for correct verb forms and sentence meaning.

examples.wrong: су развијали
examples.correct: су се развијале

examples.wrong: размножавају
examples.correct: размножавају се

examples.wrong: које меша се са снег
examples.correct: које се меша са снегом
examples.context: Reflexive particle misplaced in relative clause

top_error_patterns.description: Improper construction of clauses and phrases, such as missing 'као што је' and incorrect use of infinitive versus noun forms, leading to unclear or unnatural sentences.

examples.wrong: физичке особине као камуфлажа
examples.correct: физичких особина као што је камуфлажа

examples.wrong: за разумети
examples.correct: за разумевање
examples.context: Infinitive used instead of noun form

top_error_patterns.description: Confusion between behavioral and physical adaptations, leading to incorrect or misleading statements about scientific concepts.

examples.wrong: Понашајне адаптације су физичке промене
examples.correct: Понашајне адаптације нису физичке промене
examples.context: Behavioral adaptations incorrectly described as physical changes

top_error_patterns.description: Omission or misuse of prepositions when expressing direction, leading to unclear or incorrect meaning.

examples.wrong: Птице мигрирају југ за зиму...
examples.correct: Птице мигрирају на југ за зиму...
examples.context: Direction indicated without the required preposition 'на'.

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect verb conjugation that does not match the grammatical number of the subject, leading to minor clarity issues.

examples.wrong: Понашајне адаптације значи радње или понашања, не физичке промене.
examples.correct: Понашајне адаптације значе радње или понашања, не физичке промене.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Emoji Usage in Formal Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis are used in educational content where a formal tone is expected, which does not align with Serbian academic standards.

examples.context: Appears in quiz items where a professional presentation is required.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent mismatches between noun/adjective/verb gender and number, especially with feminine plural forms. This disrupts grammatical correctness and clarity.

examples.wrong: בעלי חיים התפתחו בדרכים מדהימים לשרוד בסביבות שלהם
examples.correct: בעלי חיים התפתחו בדרכים מדהימות לשרוד בסביבות שלהם
examples.context: Adjective does not agree with feminine plural noun

examples.wrong: הסתגלויות הוא תכונות או התנהגויות שעוזרים אורגניזמים לשרוד
examples.correct: הסתגלויות הן תכונות או התנהגויות שעוזרות לאורגניזמים לשרוד
examples.context: Copula and verb do not agree with feminine plural subject

examples.wrong: לשועל הארקטי יש פרווה לבן שמתחבר עם השלג
examples.correct: לשועל הארקטי יש פרווה לבנה שמתחברת עם השלג
examples.context: Adjective and verb do not agree with feminine noun

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect use or omission of copula forms ('הוא', 'הם', 'הן', 'זו') that do not match the gender and number of the subject, leading to ungrammatical sentences.

examples.wrong: הסתגלויות אלו מפתח להבנה איך מינים שורדים
examples.correct: הסתגלויות אלו הן מפתח להבנה איך מינים שורדים
examples.context: Missing copula for plural feminine subject

examples.wrong: הסתגלויות התנהגותיות הם שינויים פיזיים
examples.correct: הסתגלויות התנהגותיות הן שינויים פיזיים
examples.context: Copula does not agree with feminine plural subject

examples.wrong: ציפורים שנודדות כדי לברוח מהקור זה הסתגלות התנהגותי
examples.correct: ציפורים שנודדות כדי לברוח מהקור זו הסתגלות התנהגותית
examples.context: Copula and adjective do not agree with feminine singular noun

top_error_patterns.description: Verbs do not match the gender and number of their subjects, especially with feminine plural forms, resulting in confusion and lack of clarity.

examples.wrong: הסתגלויות התנהגותיות מתייחס לפעולות או התנהגויות
examples.correct: הסתגלויות התנהגותיות מתייחסות לפעולות או התנהגויות
examples.context: Verb does not agree with feminine plural subject

examples.wrong: הם מתפתח במשך דורות
examples.correct: הן מתפתחות במשך דורות
examples.context: Pronoun and verb do not agree with feminine plural subject

top_error_patterns.description: Nouns are not properly inflected in the construct state, leading to unnatural or incorrect noun phrases.

examples.wrong: סקירה הסתגלויות בעלי חיים
examples.correct: סקירת הסתגלויות בעלי חיים
examples.context: Title or heading combining nouns in a phrase

top_error_patterns.description: Definite articles are omitted before nouns where required, reducing clarity and correctness.

examples.wrong: לברוח קור
examples.correct: לברוח מהקור
examples.context: Verb phrase describing an action with a definite noun
